short_description.id: Nukekubi adalah jenis rokurokubi yang kepalanya terlepas sepenuhnya dari tubuh dan dapat terbang; kisah tentangnya populer pada zaman Edo.
short_description.en: Nukekubi is the kind of rokurokubi whose head detaches completely from the body and can fly; tales about it became popular in the Edo period.

long_description.id: Nukekubi adalah rokurokubi yang kepalanya terlepas sepenuhnya dari tubuh. Pada rokurokubi, kepala dapat terbang, entah di ujung leher panjang seperti ular atau terlepas sama sekali dari tubuh. Menurut Yokai.com, nukekubi lebih ganas dan haus darah daripada rokurokubi berleher panjang.
long_description.en: The nukekubi is a rokurokubi whose head detaches completely from the body. In a rokurokubi the head can fly off, either at the end of a long snake-like neck or fully detached from the body. According to Yokai.com, nukekubi are more violent and thirst for blood more than the long-necked rokurokubi.

long_description.id: Kisah dan gambar rokurokubi menjadi sangat populer pada zaman Edo, dan kamus mencatat banyak pustaka zaman Edo yang memuatnya. Lafcadio Hearn memuat kisah "Rokuro-kubi" dalam Kwaidan tentang seorang pendeta yang menginap bersama keluarga makhluk semacam itu. Sebuah kisah zaman Edo bahkan memuat nukekubi lelaki.
long_description.en: Tales and pictures of rokurokubi became very popular in the Edo period, and a dictionary notes many Edo-period works that record them. Lafcadio Hearn included a story called "Rokuro-kubi" in Kwaidan about a priest who stays with a family of such creatures. An Edo-period tale even includes a male nukekubi.

long_description.id: Pustaka zaman Edo kerap menafsirkan kepala yang terlepas sebagai jiwa yang mengembara keluar tubuh, seperti dalam Sorori Monogatari (1663). Yokai.com menyebut para ilmuwan zaman Edo mengira penderitanya mengidap penyakit mirip berjalan dalam tidur. Diteorikan pula bahwa bila tubuh yang tidur dipindahkan saat kepala melayang, kepala tidak dapat menyatu kembali. Penulis ensiklopedia Jepang menduga kisah kepala terbang berasal dari Tiongkok.
long_description.en: Edo-period works often interpret the detached head as the soul wandering out of the body, as in the Sorori Monogatari (1663). Yokai.com says Edo-period scientists believed sufferers had an affliction like sleepwalking. It is also theorized that if the sleeping body is moved while the head floats, the head cannot rejoin it. The author of a Japanese encyclopedia entry suspects that tales of flying heads came from China.

short_description.id: Jenglot adalah makhluk kecil dalam budaya dan mitologi Indonesia berupa boneka mirip manusia cacat, dipercaya memberi perlindungan atau keberuntungan bila diisi ilmu hitam, tetapi banyak spesimennya terbukti rekayasa.
short_description.en: The jenglot is a small creature of Indonesian culture and mythology, a deformed humanlike doll believed to give protection or luck when imbued with black magic, though many specimens have proved to be fabrications.

long_description.id: Jenglot adalah makhluk kecil dalam budaya dan mitologi Indonesia yang tampak seperti boneka manusia cacat sepanjang hingga 12 sentimeter, berambut panjang dan berkuku panjang. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Indonesia ukurannya sekitar 10-20 cm, berkulit gelap seperti mumi, berwajah seperti tengkorak dan bertaring mencuat. Boneka itu sendiri tidak berbuat apa-apa, tetapi bila diisi ilmu hitam dikatakan melindungi pemiliknya, membalas dendam kepada musuh, atau menjadi jimat keberuntungan. Jenglot dapat dijual seharga ribuan ringgit atau jutaan rupiah.
long_description.en: The jenglot is a small creature of Indonesian culture and mythology that looks like a deformed human doll up to 12 centimetres long, with long hair and long nails. According to Wikipedia it is about 10-20 cm, with dark mummy-like skin, a skull-like face and protruding fangs. The doll does nothing by itself, but when imbued with black magic it is said to protect its master, take revenge on an enemy or work as a good-luck charm. A jenglot can fetch thousands of ringgit or millions of rupiah when sold.

long_description.id: Menurut cerita rakyat, jenglot dulunya manusia. Para pemeliharanya memberinya darah kambing atau darah manusia yang diletakkan di dekatnya, dan jenglot dikatakan tidak meminum darah itu secara langsung. Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Indonesia, sebagian masyarakat percaya jenglot memiliki kekuatan mistis dan tidak selalu memakan darah manusia, dan sebagian lain percaya ia jelmaan manusia atau siluman.
long_description.en: Folklore says jenglots were once human beings. Their keepers feed them goat blood or human blood placed nearby, and the jenglot is said not to drink the blood directly. According to Wikipedia, some people believe the jenglot has mystical power and does not always consume human blood, and others believe it is the incarnation of a human or a siluman.

long_description.id: Di Indonesia beberapa kali diadakan pameran jenglot, sebagian besar spesimennya disebut ditemukan di Jawa dan Sumatra dan menjadi koleksi pribadi, dan jenglot juga dipamerkan di Museum Sultan Alam Shah, Shah Alam. Jenglot dilaporkan ditemukan di Jawa, Kalimantan, dan Bali, dan pada 27 Februari 2021 sebuah jenglot dilaporkan ditemukan di makam keramat di Kudus. Banyak jenglot terbukti palsu, berupa rangkaian taksidermi monyet dan ikan, meskipun tidak semua spesimen diperiksa. Sebagian orang menyebutnya hanya mainan buatan manusia, dan ada kesimpulan bahwa ia dibuat dari mumifikasi beberapa spesies.
long_description.en: Several jenglot exhibitions have been held in Indonesia, most specimens are said to be found on Java and Sumatra and held as private collections, and jenglots were also shown at the Sultan Alam Shah Museum in Shah Alam. Jenglots have been reported in Java, Kalimantan and Bali, and on 27 February 2021 one was reported found at a sacred grave in Kudus. Many proved to be hoaxes made from taxidermied monkeys and fish, although not all specimens were examined. Some call them merely man-made toys, and there is a conclusion that they are made by mummifying several species.

long_description.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Indonesia, tim forensik di Jakarta mendefinisikan jenglot sebagai bukan makhluk hidup dan foto sinar Rontgen tidak menemukan unsur tulang. Pada 2008, ilmuwan di Malaysia memeriksa rambut dan DNA jenglot yang dibawa dari Irian Jaya ke Kuala Lumpur oleh seorang pengusaha dan dipamerkan di sebuah museum. Karena otot sangat kering, mereka memakai rambut; semua sampel berciri manusia, hasil analisis DNA menunjuk kemungkinan satu orang yang sama, sebagian rambut tampak ditanam terbalik, dan satu sampel tampak diwarnai. Para peneliti menyimpulkan rambut itu kecil kemungkinan berasal dari spesies hewan.
long_description.en: According to Wikipedia, a forensic team in Jakarta defined the jenglot as not a living creature and X-ray photos found no bone. In 2008, scientists in Malaysia examined hair and DNA from jenglots brought from Irian Jaya to Kuala Lumpur by a businessman and exhibited in a museum. Because the muscle was very dry they used hair; all samples had human characteristics, the DNA analysis pointed to likely one and the same person, some hairs appeared implanted upside down and one sample appeared dyed. The researchers concluded the hair was unlikely to come from an animal species.

text.en: Stories of it go back hundreds of years; settler reports are recorded from 1855 and the name Ogopogo has been used since the 1920s.

short_description.id: Ogopogo adalah monster danau yang dikatakan mendiami Danau Okanagan di British Columbia, Kanada, dan berakar pada kepercayaan First Nations tentang roh danau.
short_description.en: In British Columbia, Canada, Ogopogo is the monster believed to live in Okanagan Lake, and its roots lie in First Nations belief in a lake spirit.

long_description.id: Ogopogo dikatakan mendiami Danau Okanagan di British Columbia, Kanada. Kisah tentang makhluk besar di danau itu berusia ratusan tahun dan dituturkan orang First Nations setempat, yang menganggapnya roh danau yang suci; orang Syilx menyebutnya N'ha-a-itk dan orang Secwepemc dan Syilx juga menyebutnya Naitaka. Sebagian sarjana menelusuri perkembangannya dari cerita rakyat First Nations dan motif umum monster air.
long_description.en: Ogopogo is said to live in Okanagan Lake in British Columbia, Canada. Stories of a large creature in the lake are hundreds of years old and were told by local First Nations people, who considered it a sacred lake spirit; the Syilx call it N'ha-a-itk, and the Secwepemc and Syilx also called it Naitaka. Some scholars trace its development from First Nations folklore and widespread water-monster motifs.

long_description.id: Kebanyakan kesaksian menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk menyerupai ular, hingga sekitar 15 meter, berkulit gelap licin, dengan tubuh lebih tebal daripada tiang telepon dan kepala mirip kuda atau kambing. Ia dikatakan bergerak sangat cepat dengan ekornya yang kuat, dan dalam tradisi pribumi memakai ekornya menimbulkan badai untuk menenggelamkan korban. Sumber berbeda pendapat apakah ia entitas jahat yang menuntut persembahan atau roh suci yang melindungi lembah.
long_description.en: Most accounts describe it as a snake-like creature up to about 15 meters long with smooth dark skin, a body thicker than a telephone pole, and a head like a horse or goat. It is said to move extremely fast with a powerful tail, and in native lore used its tail to raise storms and drown victims. Sources disagree on whether it is an evil entity demanding sacrifice or a sacred spirit that protects the valley.

long_description.id: Penampakan pertama oleh pemukim tercatat pada 1855, dan penulis Susan Allison melaporkan melihat sesuatu pada 1872. Nama Ogopogo diambil dari lagu music-hall Inggris pada 1920-an. Sejak itu Ogopogo menjadi atraksi wisata dan memicu hadiah satu juta dolar; Greenpeace bahkan menyatakan ia harus difilmkan, bukan ditangkap; ekspedisi ilmiah 1991 tidak menemukan tanda-tandanya, dan penjelasan yang diajukan mencakup ikan besar seperti sturgeon, fenomena geologi danau, atau batang kayu.
long_description.en: The first settler sighting is recorded in 1855, and the author Susan Allison reported seeing something in 1872. The name Ogopogo was taken from an English music-hall song in the 1920s. Since then Ogopogo has become a tourist attraction and inspired a one-million-dollar bounty, and Greenpeace even announced it should be filmed rather than captured; the 1991 scientific expedition found no sign of it, and proposed explanations include a large fish such as a sturgeon, the lake's geology, or logs.

cultural_context.id: Bagi orang Syilx, makhluk itu adalah roh suci danau yang melindungi lembah, dan First Nations setempat tidak menganggapnya sekadar cerita rakyat. Kini Ogopogo berperan dalam simbol komersial dan representasi media kawasan itu serta menjadi atraksi wisata.
cultural_context.en: To the Syilx the creature is a sacred spirit of the lake that protects the valley. Today Ogopogo features in the region's commercial symbols and media portrayals and draws tourists.

literal_meaning.id: "Roh suci danau"; terjemahan lain: "iblis air", "dewa air", atau "makhluk suci air".
literal_meaning.en: "Sacred spirit of the lake"; other translations: "water-demon", "water god", or "sacred creature of the water".

who.id: Monster danau menyerupai ular yang dikatakan mendiami Danau Okanagan.
who.en: A serpentine lake monster said to inhabit Okanagan Lake.

origin.id: Kepercayaan First Nations setempat tentang roh danau, dengan nama Ogopogo dari lagu Inggris tahun 1920-an.
origin.en: Local First Nations belief in a lake spirit, with the name Ogopogo taken from an English song of the 1920s.

role.id: Roh danau yang dihormati sekaligus menuntut persembahan untuk penyeberangan yang aman.
role.en: A revered lake spirit that also demanded sacrifice for safe crossing.

famous_for.id: Menjadi atraksi wisata setempat, seperti monster Loch Ness di Skotlandia.
famous_for.en: Becoming a local tourist attraction, much like Scotland's Loch Ness monster.

did_you_know.id: Pada 1980-an, sebuah asosiasi pariwisata Danau Okanagan menawarkan hadiah satu juta dolar bagi siapa pun yang dapat memberikan "bukti hidup" bahwa Ogopogo ada.
did_you_know.en: A tourism association around Okanagan Lake once put up a million dollars for anyone able to produce "living proof" of Ogopogo; the offer dates from the 1980s.

description.id: Naitaka kerap digambarkan memakai ekornya untuk menimbulkan badai dahsyat dan menenggelamkan korban.
description.en: The Naitaka was often described as using its tail to create fierce storms and drown victims.

description.id: Monster itu dikatakan bergerak dengan kecepatan luar biasa, melingkarkan tubuh dalam gelombang vertikal dan melaju dengan ekor kuat.

description.id: Roh suci danau yang berwarna gelap dengan kepala kuda dan tanduk rusa, dan dapat pula mengambil wujud fisik.
description.en: A sacred lake spirit, dark with a horse's head and a deer's antlers, which could also take physical form.

role.en: Naitaka drowns a canoe whose chief refused the sacrifice.

summary.id: Kepala suku tamu Timbasket menolak persembahan yang disyaratkan dan menyangkal keberadaan iblis itu. Ketika ia memasuki danau dengan kano bersama keluarganya, Naitaka mencambuk permukaan danau dengan ekor panjangnya dan kano beserta penumpangnya terhisap ke dasar.
summary.en: The visiting chief Timbasket rejected the required sacrifice and denied the demon's existence. When he entered the lake by canoe with his family, Naitaka lashed the water into waves with its long tail, and the canoe with everyone aboard was dragged down to the lake floor.

role.id: Makhluk itu menuntut persembahan.
role.en: The creature demands a sacrifice.

summary.id: Orang membawa ayam, salmon, dan hewan kecil lain untuk dilemparkan ke danau agar N'ha-a-itk tenang dan penyeberangan aman; selama ratusan tahun First Nations mengorbankan hewan kecil sebelum memasuki air.
summary.en: People brought chickens, salmon, and other small animals to toss into the lake to appease N'ha-a-itk and ensure safe crossing; for hundreds of years First Nations sacrificed small animals before entering the water.

claims.quote: The Ogopogo is a lake monster said to inhabit Okanagan Lake in British Columbia, Canada in Canadian folklore. Some scholars have charted the entity's development from First Nations folklore and widespread water monster folklore motifs.

statement.id: Ogopogo adalah monster danau yang dikatakan mendiami Danau Okanagan di British Columbia, Kanada, dalam cerita rakyat Kanada. Sebagian sarjana menelusuri perkembangan makhluk ini dari cerita rakyat First Nations dan motif umum monster air.
statement.en: The Ogopogo is a lake monster said to inhabit Okanagan Lake in British Columbia, Canada, in Canadian folklore, and some scholars have traced its development from First Nations folklore and widespread water-monster motifs.

claims.quote: Okanagan Lake is the largest of five inter-connected freshwater fjord lakes in the Okanagan Valley in British Columbia. Named after the Syilx Okanagan Nation that have lived in the valley since time immemorial, it was created when melting glaciers flooded a valley 10,000 years ago.

statement.id: Danau Okanagan adalah yang terbesar dari lima danau fyord air tawar yang saling terhubung di Lembah Okanagan, British Columbia. Dinamai menurut Bangsa Syilx Okanagan yang telah mendiami lembah itu sejak zaman purba, danau ini terbentuk ketika gletser yang mencair membanjiri sebuah lembah 10.000 tahun lalu.
statement.en: Okanagan Lake is the largest of five inter-connected freshwater fjord lakes in the Okanagan Valley, named after the Syilx Okanagan Nation who have lived there since time immemorial, and created when melting glaciers flooded a valley 10,000 years ago.

claims.quote: The lake monster has been mostly described as being a serpentine creature with smooth dark skin with a large body thicker than a telephone pole and being up to 15 m (49 ft) in length.

statement.id: Monster danau ini kebanyakan digambarkan sebagai makhluk menyerupai ular berkulit gelap licin dengan tubuh besar lebih tebal daripada tiang telepon dan panjang hingga 15 m.
statement.en: The lake monster has mostly been described as a serpentine creature with smooth dark skin and a large body thicker than a telephone pole, up to 15 m (49 ft) long.

claims.quote: The Naitaka was often described as using its tail to create fierce storms to drown victims.

statement.id: Naitaka kerap digambarkan memakai ekornya untuk menimbulkan badai dahsyat guna menenggelamkan korban.
statement.en: The Naitaka was often described as using its tail to create fierce storms to drown victims.

claims.quote: The monster has said to move at incredible speeds, coiling its body in vertical undulations, and propelling itself with a powerful tail.

statement.id: Monster itu dikatakan bergerak dengan kecepatan luar biasa, melingkarkan tubuhnya dalam gelombang vertikal, dan melaju dengan ekornya yang kuat.
statement.en: The monster is said to move at incredible speeds, coiling its body in vertical undulations and propelling itself with a powerful tail.

claims.quote: According to historian Mark M. Orkin, the creature received its colonial name "on a night in 1924 when the strains of an English music-hall song were first heard in the city of Vernon, British Columbia". Orkin cites the following lines from the song: ... And Ogopogo was his name.

statement.id: Menurut sejarawan Mark M. Orkin, makhluk ini menerima nama kolonialnya "pada suatu malam tahun 1924 ketika alunan lagu music-hall Inggris pertama kali terdengar di kota Vernon, British Columbia"; larik lagu yang ia kutip diakhiri "And Ogopogo was his name".
statement.en: According to historian Mark M. Orkin the creature received its colonial name "on a night in 1924 when the strains of an English music-hall song were first heard in the city of Vernon, British Columbia", and the song lines he cites end "And Ogopogo was his name".

claims.quote: According to Ben Radford, the Ogopogo is "more closely tied to native myths than is any other lake monster." The Secwepemc and Syilx natives regarded the Ogopogo, which they called the Naitaka, as "an evil supernatural entity with great power and ill intent."

statement.id: Menurut Ben Radford, Ogopogo "lebih erat terikat pada mitos pribumi daripada monster danau mana pun". Orang Secwepemc dan Syilx menganggap Ogopogo, yang mereka sebut Naitaka, sebagai "entitas gaib jahat dengan kekuatan besar dan niat buruk".
statement.en: According to Ben Radford the Ogopogo is "more closely tied to native myths than is any other lake monster"; the Secwepemc and Syilx natives regarded it, calling it the Naitaka, as "an evil supernatural entity with great power and ill intent".

claims.quote: In native lore, Naitaka demanded a live sacrifice for safe crossing of the lake. For hundreds of years, First Nations would sacrifice small animals before entering the water.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi pribumi, Naitaka menuntut persembahan hidup agar penyeberangan danau aman. Selama ratusan tahun, orang First Nations mengorbankan hewan kecil sebelum memasuki air.
statement.en: In native lore Naitaka demanded a live sacrifice for safe crossing of the lake, and for hundreds of years First Nations would sacrifice small animals before entering the water.

claims.quote: Oral traditions often described visiting chief Timbasket, who rejected the required sacrifice, denying the existence of the demon. Upon entering the lake on a canoe with his family, Naitaka "whipped up the surface of the lake with his long tail" and the canoe and its occupants were sucked to the bottom of the lake.

statement.id: Tradisi lisan sering menceritakan kepala suku tamu Timbasket yang menolak persembahan yang disyaratkan dan menyangkal keberadaan iblis itu. Ketika ia memasuki danau dengan kano bersama keluarganya, Naitaka "mencambuk permukaan danau dengan ekor panjangnya" dan kano beserta penumpangnya terhisap ke dasar danau.
statement.en: Oral traditions often described the visiting chief Timbasket, who rejected the required sacrifice and denied the demon's existence; when he entered the lake by canoe with his family, Naitaka "whipped up the surface of the lake with his long tail" and the canoe and its occupants were sucked to the bottom.

claims.quote: According to Pat Raphael of the Westbank First Nation, a member nation of the larger Okanagan Nation Alliance, the demonic view of Naitaka came about through miscommunication between Canada's early European settlers and the Syilx/Okanagan people. To the Syilx, it's ... a sacred spirit of the lake that protects the valley.

statement.id: Menurut Pat Raphael dari Westbank First Nation, pandangan yang menganggap Naitaka iblis muncul dari salah komunikasi antara pemukim Eropa awal di Kanada dan orang Syilx/Okanagan. Bagi orang Syilx, ia adalah roh suci danau yang melindungi lembah.
statement.en: According to Pat Raphael of the Westbank First Nation, the demonic view of Naitaka arose from miscommunication between early European settlers and the Syilx/Okanagan people; to the Syilx it is a sacred spirit of the lake that protects the valley.

claims.quote: However, Jordan Coble of the Westbank First Nation counters by saying that the creature is a being that is meant to be both respected, not feared.

statement.id: Namun Jordan Coble dari Westbank First Nation menyanggah dengan mengatakan bahwa makhluk itu adalah sosok yang dimaksudkan untuk dihormati, bukan ditakuti.
statement.en: Jordan Coble of the Westbank First Nation counters that the creature is a being meant to be respected, not feared.

claims.quote: The Naitaka was often described as using its tail to create fierce storms to drown victims. In 1855, settler John MacDougal claimed that his horses were sucked down into the water, and nearly his canoe before he cut the line.

statement.id: Naitaka kerap digambarkan memakai ekornya untuk menimbulkan badai dahsyat guna menenggelamkan korban. Pada 1855, pemukim John MacDougal mengaku kudanya terhisap ke dalam air, dan hampir kanonya sebelum ia memotong talinya.
statement.en: The Naitaka was often described as using its tail to create fierce storms to drown victims; in 1855 settler John MacDougal claimed his horses were sucked down into the water, and nearly his canoe before he cut the line.

claims.quote: In the 1980s, a local tourism agency offered a cash reward for a proven sighting of the beast. Greenpeace announced that the beast must be filmed and not captured: the Ogopogo was listed as an endangered species.

statement.id: Pada 1980-an, sebuah lembaga pariwisata setempat menawarkan hadiah uang tunai bagi penampakan makhluk itu yang terbukti. Greenpeace menyatakan makhluk itu harus difilmkan dan tidak ditangkap: Ogopogo didaftarkan sebagai spesies terancam.
statement.en: In the 1980s a local tourism agency offered a cash reward for a proven sighting of the beast, and Greenpeace announced it must be filmed and not captured, listing the Ogopogo as an endangered species.

claims.quote: In 2011, a cell phone video captured two dark shapes in the water. A suggested explanation is that the video shows two logs.

statement.id: Pada 2011, sebuah video ponsel merekam dua bentuk gelap di air. Penjelasan yang diajukan adalah bahwa video itu menunjukkan dua batang kayu.
statement.en: In 2011 a cell phone video captured two dark shapes in the water; a suggested explanation is that it shows two logs.

claims.quote: Ogopogo is the name of a legendary lake monster that is said to live in Okanagan Lake in the Canadian province of British Columbia. Stories of a large creature living in the lake go back hundreds of years and were told by the region’s First Nations people who believed it to be a sacred lake spirit.

statement.id: Ogopogo adalah nama monster danau legendaris yang dikatakan hidup di Danau Okanagan di provinsi British Columbia, Kanada. Kisah tentang makhluk besar di danau itu sudah berusia ratusan tahun dan dituturkan orang First Nations setempat yang meyakininya sebagai roh danau yang suci.
statement.en: Ogopogo is a legendary lake monster said to live in Okanagan Lake in British Columbia, and stories of a large creature in the lake go back hundreds of years, told by the region's First Nations people who believed it to be a sacred lake spirit.

claims.quote: While eyewitness accounts vary, most describe Ogopogo as a snake-like creature about 80-feet (24-meters) long with a head resembling a horse or a goat.

statement.id: Meskipun kesaksian berbeda-beda, kebanyakan menggambarkan Ogopogo sebagai makhluk menyerupai ular sepanjang sekitar 80 kaki (24 meter) dengan kepala mirip kuda atau kambing.
statement.en: While eyewitness accounts vary, most describe Ogopogo as a snake-like creature about 80 feet (24 meters) long with a head resembling a horse or a goat.

claims.quote: To the Syilx, the creature was known as N’ha-a-itk, which means “sacred spirit of the lake.” N’ha-a-itk was said to be dark in color with the head of a horse and the antlers of a deer. According to local legend, N’ha-a-itk was a spirit that could also take physical form.

statement.id: Bagi orang Syilx, makhluk itu dikenal sebagai N'ha-a-itk, yang berarti "roh suci danau". N'ha-a-itk dikatakan berwarna gelap dengan kepala kuda dan tanduk rusa. Menurut legenda setempat, N'ha-a-itk adalah roh yang juga dapat mengambil wujud fisik.
statement.en: To the Syilx the creature was known as N'ha-a-itk, meaning "sacred spirit of the lake", said to be dark with the head of a horse and the antlers of a deer, and according to local legend a spirit that could also take physical form.

claims.quote: It was said to live in a cave near an island and required a sacrifice to allow the safe passage of the lake. The people were said to bring chickens, salmon, and other small animals with them to toss into the lake to appease N’ha-a-itk.

statement.id: Makhluk itu dikatakan tinggal di gua dekat sebuah pulau dan menuntut persembahan agar penyeberangan danau aman. Orang-orang dikatakan membawa ayam, salmon, dan hewan kecil lain untuk dilemparkan ke danau guna menenangkan N'ha-a-itk.
statement.en: It was said to live in a cave near an island and required a sacrifice for safe passage on the lake; people were said to bring chickens, salmon, and other small animals to toss into the lake to appease N'ha-a-itk.

claims.quote: The first recorded sighting by a settler occurred in 1855, when a man claimed that something dragged his horses underwater as he tried to cross the lake. In 1872, a Canadian author named Susan Allison reported that she saw a dinosaur swimming in Okanagan Lake.

statement.id: Penampakan pertama yang tercatat oleh seorang pemukim terjadi pada 1855, ketika seorang pria mengaku ada sesuatu yang menyeret kudanya ke bawah air saat ia menyeberangi danau. Pada 1872, penulis Kanada bernama Susan Allison melaporkan melihat seekor dinosaurus berenang di Danau Okanagan.
statement.en: The first recorded sighting by a settler occurred in 1855, when a man claimed something dragged his horses underwater as he tried to cross the lake; in 1872 a Canadian author, Susan Allison, reported seeing a dinosaur swimming in Okanagan Lake.

claims.quote: In the 1920s, local tourism officials decided to call the creature Ogopogo, a name taken from a popular English folk song The Ogo-Pogo.

statement.id: Pada 1920-an, pejabat pariwisata setempat memutuskan menamai makhluk itu Ogopogo, nama yang diambil dari lagu rakyat Inggris populer The Ogo-Pogo.
statement.en: In the 1920s local tourism officials decided to call the creature Ogopogo, a name taken from a popular English folk song, The Ogo-Pogo.

claims.quote: During the 1980s, an Okanagan Lake tourism association offered a one-million-dollar reward for anyone who could provide “living proof” that Ogopogo really existed.

statement.id: Pada 1980-an, sebuah asosiasi pariwisata Danau Okanagan menawarkan hadiah satu juta dolar bagi siapa pun yang dapat memberikan "bukti hidup" bahwa Ogopogo benar-benar ada.
statement.en: During the 1980s an Okanagan Lake tourism association offered a one-million-dollar reward for anyone who could provide "living proof" that Ogopogo really existed.

claims.quote: In 1991, a scientific expedition conducted a high-tech search of the lake for evidence that it was home to a giant aquatic creature. The expedition included an underwater remote-controlled vehicle and a submarine, but no sign of an Ogopogo was discovered.

statement.id: Pada 1991, sebuah ekspedisi ilmiah mencari bukti di danau dengan teknologi tinggi bahwa danau itu rumah bagi makhluk air raksasa. Ekspedisi itu memakai kendaraan bawah air kendali jarak jauh dan kapal selam, tetapi tak ada tanda Ogopogo ditemukan.
statement.en: In 1991 a scientific expedition made a high-tech search of the lake for evidence of a giant aquatic creature, using an underwater remote-controlled vehicle and a submarine, but no sign of an Ogopogo was discovered.

claims.quote: A more logical explanation is that the “monster” may be a large fish such as a sturgeon. ... An even more plausible explanation is that Ogopogo may be nothing more than a phenomenon caused by the lake’s geology.

statement.id: Penjelasan yang lebih logis adalah bahwa "monster" itu mungkin ikan besar seperti sturgeon. Penjelasan yang lebih masuk akal lagi adalah bahwa Ogopogo mungkin hanyalah fenomena akibat geologi danau.
statement.en: A more logical explanation is that the "monster" may be a large fish such as a sturgeon, and an even more plausible one is that Ogopogo may be nothing more than a phenomenon caused by the lake's geology.

claims.quote: The creature was most often said to be multi-humped with the head of a horse and green, black, or gray skin. Other reports claimed that it had the head of a goat, a snake, or even an alligator.

statement.id: Makhluk itu paling sering dikatakan berpunuk banyak dengan kepala kuda dan kulit hijau, hitam, atau abu-abu. Laporan lain menyebut kepalanya seperti kambing, ular, atau bahkan aligator.
statement.en: The creature was most often said to be multi-humped with the head of a horse and green, black, or gray skin; other reports claimed the head of a goat, a snake, or even an alligator.

claims.quote: Additionally, the creature may sometimes be referred to by the pet name Oggy. Smaller creatures may be referred to as Ogopups.

statement.id: Selain itu, makhluk ini kadang disebut dengan nama sayang Oggy. Makhluk yang lebih kecil dapat disebut Ogopup.
statement.en: The creature may sometimes be referred to by the pet name Oggy, and smaller creatures may be referred to as Ogopups.

claims.quote: Stories of the lake monster were featured on American television shows such as Unsolved Mysteries and In Search Of.

statement.id: Kisah monster danau itu diangkat dalam acara televisi Amerika seperti Unsolved Mysteries dan In Search Of.
statement.en: Stories of the lake monster were featured on American television shows such as Unsolved Mysteries and In Search Of.

claims.quote: The Ogopogo now plays a role in the commercial symbolism and media representation of the region.

statement.id: Ogopogo kini berperan dalam simbol komersial dan representasi media kawasan itu.
statement.en: The Ogopogo now plays a role in the commercial symbolism and media representation of the region.

claims.quote: Similar to Scotland’s famed Loch Ness monster, Ogopogo has become a local tourist attraction and even inspired a one-million-dollar bounty for proof of its existence.

statement.id: Seperti monster Loch Ness yang terkenal di Skotlandia, Ogopogo menjadi atraksi wisata setempat dan bahkan memicu hadiah satu juta dolar bagi bukti keberadaannya.
statement.en: Like Scotland's famed Loch Ness monster, Ogopogo has become a local tourist attraction and even inspired a one-million-dollar bounty for proof of its existence.

claims.quote: The word "n'ha-a-itk" has various translations, such as "water-demon", "water god", or "sacred creature of the water".

statement.id: Kata "n'ha-a-itk" punya beberapa terjemahan, seperti "iblis air", "dewa air", atau "makhluk suci air".
statement.en: The word "n'ha-a-itk" has various translations, such as "water-demon", "water god", or "sacred creature of the water".

claims.quote: As outsiders began to move into the region in the nineteenth century, they heard stories of N’ha-a-itk and interpreted the spirit as a giant snake-like monster.

statement.id: Ketika orang luar mulai pindah ke kawasan itu pada abad ke-19, mereka mendengar kisah tentang N'ha-a-itk dan menafsirkan roh itu sebagai monster raksasa menyerupai ular.
statement.en: As outsiders began to move into the region in the nineteenth century they heard stories of N'ha-a-itk and interpreted the spirit as a giant snake-like monster.

claims.quote: The spirit was said to dwell in caves under Rattlesnake Island (a.k.a. Monster Island) or adjacent to Squally Point.

statement.id: Roh itu dikatakan berdiam di gua-gua di bawah Rattlesnake Island (alias Monster Island) atau di dekat Squally Point.
statement.en: The spirit was said to dwell in caves under Rattlesnake Island (a.k.a. Monster Island) or adjacent to Squally Point.

short_description.id: Ular Pelangi adalah dewa yang umum dan sering dipandang sebagai pencipta dalam mitologi Aborigin Australia, dikenal dengan banyak nama dan dikaitkan dengan air serta hujan.
short_description.en: The Rainbow Serpent is a common deity, often seen as the creator god, in Australian Aboriginal mythology, known by many names and associated with water and rain.

long_description.id: Ular Pelangi (Rainbow Serpent atau Rainbow Snake) adalah dewa yang umum, sering dipandang sebagai pencipta, dan dikenal dengan banyak nama dalam berbagai bahasa Aborigin. Ia adalah motif umum dalam seni dan agama banyak masyarakat Aborigin. Ensiklopedia agama menyebutnya tokoh mitologis yang hampir ada di mana-mana namun sulit ditangkap di seluruh benua Australia. Banyak nama dan kisah menyertainya, semuanya menunjukkan pentingnya dan kekuatannya dalam mitologi Aborigin, termasuk pandangan dunia yang disebut The Dreaming.
long_description.en: The Rainbow Serpent, also called the Rainbow Snake, is a widespread deity often regarded as a creator, with many names across Aboriginal languages. It recurs in the art and religion of many Aboriginal Australian peoples. An encyclopedia of religion describes it as a mythological figure found almost everywhere on the continent yet hard to pin down. Many names and stories surround it, all conveying its significance and power within Aboriginal mythology, including the worldview known as The Dreaming.

long_description.id: Ular Pelangi dipandang sebagai pemberi kehidupan melalui kaitannya dengan air, tetapi dapat menjadi kekuatan yang merusak bila marah. Tidak semua mitos menggambarkannya sebagai ular, dan tidak semuanya mengaitkannya dengan pelangi, tetapi kaitan dengan air atau hujan bersifat khas. Bagi masyarakat Arnhem Land bagian barat, ia secara tradisional adalah simbol badai monsun, hujan, banjir, dan bahaya.
long_description.en: It is seen as a source of life because of its link with water, yet it can turn destructive when angered. Not every myth portrays it as a snake, and not every one ties it to a rainbow, but a connection with water or rain is typical. For the people of western Arnhem Land it is traditionally a symbol of monsoon storms, rain, floods and danger.

long_description.id: Dalam salah satu pandangan tradisional Arnhem Land bagian barat, ia adalah pencipta dan ibu pertama yang melahirkan orang-orang yang dikandungnya. Ahli lain mengaitkannya dengan datangnya hujan, bertambahnya jenis-jenis alam, dan kelangsungan umat manusia. Ratusan mitos menceritakan zaman penciptaan ketika lanskap terbentuk, dan Ular Pelangi berperan aktif dalam sebagian besar mitos itu.
long_description.en: In one traditional western Arnhem Land view, it is the creator and first mother who gives birth to the people she carries inside her. Elkin links it to the arrival of rain, the multiplication of living species and the survival of humankind. Hundreds of myths narrate the creative era when the landscape took shape, and the Rainbow Snake takes an active part in most of them.

long_description.id: Di kalangan orang Kuninjku, Ngalyod, Ular Pelangi, adalah leluhur pencipta perempuan yang mahakuasa dan mampu melakukan tindakan baik maupun jahat. Ia tampak di langit sebagai pelangi dan terutama dikaitkan dengan perairan tempat ia tinggal; gemuruh air terjun dikatakan suaranya. Orang Kuninjku sering menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk menakutkan yang menelan manusia lalu memuntahkannya kembali dalam keadaan berubah.
long_description.en: Among the Kuninjku, Ngalyod, the Rainbow Serpent, is an all-powerful female ancestral creator capable of both benevolent and malevolent actions. She is visible in the sky as the rainbow and is mostly associated with the bodies of water where she resides; the roar of waterfalls is said to be her voice. The Kuninjku frequently portray her as a terrifying being that engulfs people and then brings them back up, changed by her blood.

cultural_context.id: Bagi A. R. Radcliffe-Brown, Ular Pelangi adalah perwujudan terpenting dari kekuatan alam yang kreatif dan merusak, terutama terkait hujan dan air. Menurut sumber yang sama, ia bukan semata perusak, melainkan simbol dan pengingat akan kekuatan alam yang bisa menakutkan sekaligus megah.
cultural_context.en: For A. R. Radcliffe-Brown the Rainbow Snake was the foremost embodiment of nature's creative and destructive force, chiefly tied to rain and water. According to the same source, it is not merely a destroyer but a symbol and reminder of the forces of nature, which can be fearsome as well as splendid.

did_you_know.id: Radcliffe-Brown menyimpulkan bahwa bunyip di Victoria bukan Ular Pelangi, tetapi Charles P. Mountford memasukkan bunyip ke dalam kategori yang sama.

description.id: Ular Pelangi menciptakan daratan dan keragaman bagi orang Aborigin.
description.en: The Rainbow Serpent creates land and diversity for the Aboriginal people.

description.id: Ngalyod dikagumi karena kemampuannya yang tampak untuk memperbarui hidupnya dengan berganti kulit dan muncul kembali sebagai yang baru.
description.en: Ngalyod is held in awe for her apparent ability to renew her life by shedding her skin and emerging anew.

description.id: Di Arnhem Land bagian barat, Ular Pelangi disebut Ambidj di kalangan Maung dan Ngalyod di kalangan penutur Gunwinggu; orang Kuninjku menggambarkan Ngalyod sebagai leluhur pencipta perempuan yang mahakuasa.
description.en: In western Arnhem Land the Rainbow Snake is called Ambidj among the Maung and Ngalyod among Gunwinggu speakers; the Kuninjku describe Ngalyod as an all-powerful female ancestral creator.

description.id: Yurlunggur adalah nama ular pelangi menurut Murngin dan dianggap sebagai "sang bapak agung".
description.en: Yurlunggur is the name of the rainbow serpent according to the Murngin and was considered "the great father".

description.id: Dalam tradisi Kabi Kabi, pelangi dikatakan Ular Pelangi (Dhakkan) yang berpindah dari satu lubang air ke lubang air lain.
description.en: In Kabi Kabi lore the rainbow is said to be the Rainbow Serpent (Dhakkan) moving from one water-hole to another.

role.id: Pencipta yang melahirkan manusia.

summary.en: In one traditional western Arnhem Land view, the Rainbow Snake travels under the sea from the northwest and on the mainland eventually gives birth to the people she carries inside her.

title.id: Ular yang menelan orang di tempat pelanggaran
title.en: The serpent who swallows the people at a disturbed place

role.id: Menelan orang-orang lalu memuntahkan tulang mereka.
role.en: Swallows people and vomits their bones.

summary.id: Dalam kisah yang dituturkan perempuan Gunwinggu di Oenpelli, Ular Pelangi muncul seperti mimpi dan menelan semua orang di suatu tempat, membawa mereka sebentar, lalu memuntahkan tulang mereka dan tulang itu berubah menjadi batu.
summary.en: In an account told by Gunwinggu women at Oenpelli, the Rainbow Snake comes up like a dream and swallows all the people at a place, carries them about for a while, then vomits their bones, which turn into stone.

description.id: Di wilayah ini Ular Pelangi secara tradisional menjadi simbol badai monsun, hujan, banjir, dan bahaya, dan dikenal dengan nama seperti Ambidj dan Ngalyod.
description.en: In this region the Rainbow Snake is traditionally a symbol of monsoon storms, rain, floods and danger, and is known by names such as Ambidj and Ngalyod.

note.id: Dalam seni Kuninjku, kisah Yawkyawk (roh putri duyung) dan Ngalyod, Ular Pelangi, saling terkait.
note.en: In Kuninjku art, the stories of Yawkyawk (the mermaid spirit) and Ngalyod, the Rainbow Serpent, are linked.

note.id: Di wilayah Ungarinyin, roh wandjina dapat menjadi perwujudan Ular Pelangi dan kadang disebut Ungud.
note.en: In Ungarinyin territory, wandjina spirits can be manifestations of the Rainbow Snake and are sometimes called Ungud.

note.id: Radcliffe-Brown menyimpulkan bunyip di Victoria bukan Ular Pelangi, sedangkan Mountford memasukkan bunyip ke kategori yang sama.
note.en: Radcliffe-Brown concluded the bunyip in Victoria was not a Rainbow Snake, whereas Mountford included bunyips in the same category.

statement.en: In an account told by Gunwinggu women at Oenpelli, she comes up like a dream and swallows all those people, carries them about for a while, then vomits their bones, which turn into stone.

claims.quote: Among the most important mythic characters are the wandjina (wondjina ), well known to the outside world through cave and bark paintings. In Ungarinyin territory, these spirits, which can be manifestations of Rainbow Snake, are also sometimes called Ungud.

statement.id: Di wilayah Ungarinyin, roh-roh itu (wandjina), yang dapat menjadi perwujudan Ular Pelangi, kadang juga disebut Ungud.
statement.en: In Ungarinyin territory, these spirits (the wandjina), which can be manifestations of the Rainbow Snake, are also sometimes called Ungud.

claims.quote: Although Radcliffe-Brown concludes that the bunyip in Victoria was not a Rainbow Snake, Charles P. Mountford (1978) includes bunyip s, as well as other Snake-like characters, in this category of beings.

statement.id: Meskipun Radcliffe-Brown menyimpulkan bahwa bunyip di Victoria bukan Ular Pelangi, Charles P. Mountford (1978) memasukkan bunyip, bersama tokoh mirip ular lainnya, ke dalam kategori makhluk ini.
statement.en: Although Radcliffe-Brown concludes that the bunyip in Victoria was not a Rainbow Snake, Charles P. Mountford (1978) includes bunyips, along with other snake-like characters, in this category of beings.

claims.quote: In Kuninjku art, two female transformational beings whose stories are linked – the Yawkyawk or Ngalkunburriyaymi (the young girl, mermaid spirit) and Ngalyod, the Rainbow Serpent, an all-powerful ancestral creator) are magically brought to life.

statement.id: Dalam seni Kuninjku, dua makhluk perempuan yang dapat berubah wujud dan kisahnya saling terkait, yaitu Yawkyawk atau Ngalkunburriyaymi (gadis muda, roh putri duyung) dan Ngalyod, Ular Pelangi, digambarkan seolah hidup secara ajaib.
statement.en: In Kuninjku art, two female transformational beings whose stories are linked, the Yawkyawk or Ngalkunburriyaymi (the young girl, mermaid spirit) and Ngalyod, the Rainbow Serpent, are magically brought to life.

topic.en: Whether the bunyip belongs with the Rainbow Snake

summary.en: Radcliffe-Brown concluded the bunyip in Victoria was not a Rainbow Snake.

short_description.id: Naga Korea adalah makhluk legenda dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Korea.
short_description.en: Korean dragons are legendary creatures of Korean mythology and folklore.

long_description.id: Naga Korea adalah makhluk legenda dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Korea. Mir atau Miri termasuk nama naga dalam bahasa Korea.
long_description.en: Korean dragons are legendary creatures of Korean mythology and folklore. Mir or Miri are Korean names for dragons.

long_description.id: Naga ini terutama dikaitkan dengan air, pertanian, hujan, dan awan. Legenda Munmu mengisahkan keinginannya menjadi naga Laut Timur untuk melindungi kerajaan. Naga Korea digambarkan memiliki janggut lebih panjang dibanding naga Tiongkok. Penggambaran dapat menyertakan bola yeouiju pada cakar atau mulutnya.
long_description.en: These dragons are primarily associated with water, agriculture, rain, and clouds. The Munmu legend recounts his wish to become an East Sea dragon protecting the kingdom. Korean dragons are described with longer beards than Chinese dragons. Depictions may include a yeouiju orb in the claws or mouth.

long_description.id: Samguk Yusa memuat banyak kisah naga. Seorang raja berwasiat ingin menjadi naga besar pelindung negara, dan catatan kuil menyebut Raja Munmu menjadi naga laut. Dalam kisah lain, naga laut mempersembahkan sabuk giok hitam, naga Laut Timur muncul bersama tujuh putranya setelah sebuah kuil didirikan untuk dirinya, dan seekor naga laut pernah merenggut istri seorang bangsawan lalu mengembalikannya. Dua perempuan dalam kisah lain menyebut naga-naga suami mereka sebagai naga pelindung negara.
long_description.en: The Samguk Yusa contains many dragon stories. A king left a wish to become a great dragon protecting the state, and a temple record says King Munmu became a sea dragon. Elsewhere a sea dragon offers a black jade belt, the East Sea dragon appears with seven sons after a temple is built for it, and a sea dragon once seized a lord's wife and returned her. In another story two women describe their dragon husbands as dragons protecting the country.

title.en: The king who wished to become a dragon guarding the state

summary.en: The Samguk Yusa records a king's wish to become a great dragon protecting the state, and a temple record says King Munmu became a sea dragon.

summary.en: The king sails to a mountain in the sea; a dragon presents a black jade belt, and the late king's father is said to have become a sea dragon.

role.en: The East Sea dragon honoured with a temple

summary.id: Kabut yang disebut perubahan wujud naga Laut Timur hilang setelah dibangun kuil Buddha untuk sang naga; sang naga lalu muncul bersama tujuh putranya, dan salah satunya menjadi Cheoyong.
summary.en: Fog said to be a transformation of the East Sea dragon cleared after a Buddhist temple was ordered for it; the dragon then appeared with seven sons, one of whom became Cheoyong.

sources.title: 三國遺事/卷第二 (Samguk Yusa, juan 2)

claims.quote: Korean dragons (Korean: 용/룡) are legendary creatures in Korean mythology and folklore. It is also called Mir (미르) or Miri (미리) in Korean.

statement.id: Naga Korea adalah makhluk legenda dalam mitologi dan cerita rakyat Korea.
statement.en: Korean dragons are legendary creatures of Korean mythology and folklore.

claims.quote: Korean dragons (Korean: 용/룡) are legendary creatures in Korean mythology and folklore. It is also called Mir (미르) or Miri (미리) in Korean.

statement.id: Mir atau Miri termasuk nama naga dalam bahasa Korea.
statement.en: Mir or Miri are Korean names for dragons.

claims.quote: Whereas most dragons in European mythology are linked to the elements of fire and destruction, dragons in Korean mythology are primarily benevolent beings related to water and agriculture, often considered bringers of rain and clouds. Hence, many Korean dragons are said to have resided in rivers, lakes, oceans, or even deep mountain ponds.

statement.id: Naga ini terutama dikaitkan dengan air, pertanian, hujan, dan awan.
statement.en: These dragons are primarily associated with water, agriculture, rain, and clouds.

claims.quote: One particular Korean legend speaks of the great King Munmu, who on his deathbed wished to become a "Great dragon of the East Sea in order to protect his kingdom".

statement.id: Legenda Munmu mengisahkan keinginannya menjadi naga Laut Timur untuk melindungi kerajaan.
statement.en: The Munmu legend recounts his wish to become an East Sea dragon protecting the kingdom.

claims.quote: The Korean dragon is in many ways very similar in appearance to other East Asian dragons such as the Chinese and Japanese dragons. It differs from the Chinese dragon in that it developed a longer beard.

statement.id: Naga Korea digambarkan memiliki janggut lebih panjang dibanding naga Tiongkok.
statement.en: Korean dragons are described with longer beards than Chinese dragons.

claims.quote: Occasionally a dragon may be depicted as carrying a giant orb known as the yeouiju (여의주), the Korean name for the mythical Cintamani, in its claws or its mouth.

statement.id: Penggambaran dapat menyertakan bola yeouiju pada cakar atau mulutnya.
statement.en: Depictions may include a yeouiju orb in the claws or mouth.

claims.quote: 遺詔葬於東海中大巖上。王平時常謂智義法師曰。朕身後願為護國大龍。崇奉佛法。守護邦家。

statement.id: Dalam Samguk Yusa, seorang raja yang berwasiat dimakamkan di batu karang besar di Laut Timur pernah berkata kepada guru Dharma Jiui (智義) bahwa setelah wafat ia ingin menjadi naga besar pelindung negara, yang memuliakan ajaran Buddha dan menjaga negerinya.
statement.en: In the Samguk Yusa, a king whose will asked for burial on a great rock in the East Sea once told the Dharma master Jiui (智義) that after his death he wished to become a great dragon protecting the state, revering the Buddhist teaching and guarding the country.

claims.quote: 寺中記云。文武王欲鎮倭兵。故始創此寺。未畢而崩。為海龍。其子神文立開耀二年畢。

statement.id: Catatan kuil yang dikutip Samguk Yusa menyebut Raja Munmu (文武王) mulai membangun kuil itu untuk menekan pasukan Wa (Jepang), wafat sebelum selesai, dan menjadi naga laut; putranya Sinmun (神文) menyelesaikannya pada tahun kedua era Kaiyao.
statement.en: A temple record cited in the Samguk Yusa says King Munmu (文武王) began the temple to suppress the Wa (Japanese) troops, died before it was finished, and became a sea dragon; his son Sinmun (神文) completed it in the second year of the Kaiyao era.

claims.quote: 至其月十六日風霽波平。王泛海入其山。有龍奉黑玉帶來獻。迎接共坐。
claims.locator: Samguk Yusa juan 2, bagian seruling Manpa

statement.id: Dalam kisah seruling bambu, pada hari keenam belas bulan itu, ketika angin reda dan ombak tenang, raja berlayar menuju sebuah gunung di laut, dan seekor naga datang mempersembahkan sabuk batu giok hitam serta menyambutnya duduk bersama.
statement.en: In the story of the bamboo flute, on the sixteenth day of that month, when the wind cleared and the waves calmed, the king sails to a mountain in the sea, and a dragon comes to present a black jade belt and receives him to sit together.

claims.quote: 今王考為海中大龍。庾信復為天神。二聖同心。出此無價大寶。令我獻之。
claims.locator: Samguk Yusa juan 2, bagian seruling Manpa

statement.id: Dalam kisah itu, ayah mendiang raja yang berkuasa disebut telah menjadi naga besar di laut dan Kim Yushin (庾信) menjadi dewa langit; keduanya bersepakat mengeluarkan harta tak ternilai untuk dipersembahkan.
statement.en: In that story, the late father of the reigning king is said to have become a great dragon in the sea and Kim Yushin (庾信) a heavenly god; together the two sages bring out a priceless treasure to be presented.

claims.quote: 忽雲霧冥曀。迷失道路。怪問左右。日官奏云。此東海龍所變也。宜行勝事以解之。於是敕有司為龍刱佛寺。近境施令已出。雲開霧散。

statement.id: Ketika awan dan kabut tiba-tiba menggelapkan jalan hingga rombongan tersesat, seorang pejabat (日官) berkata bahwa itu perubahan wujud naga Laut Timur dan perlu dilakukan perbuatan baik; setelah perintah mendirikan kuil Buddha untuk sang naga dikeluarkan, awan dan kabut menghilang.
statement.en: When clouds and fog suddenly darkened the way so that the party lost its path, an official (日官) said it was a transformation of the East Sea dragon and that a good deed should be performed; once the order to build a Buddhist temple for the dragon was issued, the clouds and fog cleared.

claims.quote: 東海龍喜。乃率七子現於駕前。讚德獻舞奏樂。其一子隨駕入京。輔佐王政。名曰處容。

statement.id: Naga Laut Timur yang senang membawa tujuh putranya muncul di depan kereta, memuji kebajikan serta mempersembahkan tarian dan musik; salah satu putranya mengikuti ke ibu kota, membantu pemerintahan, dan bernama Cheoyong (處容).
statement.en: The pleased East Sea dragon led seven sons to appear before the carriage, praised virtue and offered dance and music; one son followed to the capital, assisted the royal government, and was named Cheoyong (處容).

claims.quote: 又有臨海亭。晝膳次海龍忽攬夫人入海。公顛倒躄地。計無所出。又有一老人告曰。故人有言。眾口鑠金。今海中傍生。何不畏眾口乎。宜進界內民。作歌唱之。以杖打岸。則可見夫人矣。公從之。龍奉夫人出海獻之。
claims.locator: Samguk Yusa juan 2, bagian Nyonya Suro

statement.id: Di sebuah paviliun tepi laut, naga laut tiba-tiba merenggut istri seorang bangsawan (公) dan membawanya ke laut; atas saran seorang lelaki tua, rakyat bernyanyi sambil memukul tepi pantai dengan tongkat, lalu sang naga mengembalikan sang istri.
statement.en: At a seaside pavilion a sea dragon suddenly seized a lord's (公) wife and took her into the sea; on the advice of an old man, the people sang while striking the shore with sticks, and the dragon returned her.

claims.quote: 唐使將河西國二人而來。咒我夫二龍及芬皇寺井等三龍。變為小魚。筒貯而歸。願陛下敕二人。留我夫等。護國龍也。

statement.id: Dalam sebuah kisah, dua perempuan berkata bahwa utusan Tang (唐) dan dua orang dari Hexi (河西) mengubah dua naga suami mereka dan naga sumur Kuil Fenhuang (芬皇寺) menjadi ikan kecil dan membawanya dalam tabung; mereka memohon agar para naga itu, yang disebut naga pelindung negara, ditahan di negeri itu.
statement.en: In one story, two women say that an envoy of Tang (唐) and two men from Hexi (河西) transformed their husbands, two dragons, and the dragon of the well of Fenhuang temple (芬皇寺) into small fish and took them away in a tube; they beg that the dragons, described as dragons protecting the country, be kept in the land.

short_description.id: Longma adalah kuda bersayap dengan sisik naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok. Kemunculannya dipandang sebagai pertanda seorang penguasa bijak.
short_description.en: Longma is a winged horse bearing dragon scales in Chinese mythology. Its appearance was seen as an omen of a sage ruler.

long_description.id: Longma adalah kuda bersayap dengan sisik naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok. Kemunculannya dipandang sebagai pertanda seorang penguasa bijak.
long_description.en: Longma is a winged horse with dragon scales in Chinese mythology. Its appearance is regarded as an omen of a sage ruler.

long_description.id: Namanya menggabungkan kata long untuk naga dan ma untuk kuda. Teks Zhouli menyebut kuda setinggi delapan chi ke atas disebut long, sedangkan Liji menyebut "河出馬圖" (sungai mengeluarkan bagan kuda) di antara pertanda tata kelola yang selaras.
long_description.en: Its name joins long for dragon with ma for horse. The Zhouli text says horses of eight chi and above are called long, while the Liji lists "the river brings forth the horse chart" (河出馬圖) among the portents of harmonious governance.

long_description.id: Sebuah komentar kuno menyatakan bahwa longma bertubuh kuda dan bersisik naga, longma sejati bersayap di sisinya dan berjalan di atas air tanpa tenggelam, serta keluar dari sungai membawa peta ketika seorang suci berada di atas takhta. Secara tradisional, longma menyingkapkan Hetu kepada Fu Xi atau Shun.
long_description.en: An ancient commentary states that the longma has a horse's body with dragon scales, that a true dragon horse has wings at its sides and walks on water without sinking, and that it comes out of the river carrying a map when a holy man is on the throne. Traditionally a longma revealed the Hetu to Fu Xi or Shun.

long_description.id: Seekor longma yang muncul pada 741 dianggap pertanda baik bagi Kaisar Xuanzong dari Tang; ia berbintik biru dan merah, bersisik, dan induknya adalah kuda biasa yang hamil setelah meminum air sungai. Dalam cerita lain yang dicatat artikel ini, naga yang berganti wujud kawin dengan kuda betina dan melahirkan kuda liar yang sulit dijinakkan.
long_description.en: In 741 a longma appeared that was taken as favourable for Emperor Xuanzong of Tang; it was spotted in blue and red and scaly, and its mother was an ordinary horse that conceived by drinking river water. In another story recorded in the article, dragons changing form couple with mares and sire a wild horse difficult to tame.

description.id: Longma sejati disebut bersayap di sisinya dan berjalan di atas air tanpa tenggelam; seekor longma disebut dapat menempuh tiga ratus mil.
description.en: A true dragon horse is said to have wings at its sides and to walk on water without sinking; one longma is said to cover three hundred miles.

role.id: Longma menyingkapkan Hetu kepada penguasa purba.
role.en: The longma reveals the Hetu to an ancient ruler.

summary.id: Menurut artikel, seekor longma menyingkapkan Hetu kepada Fu Xi atau Shun, dan komentar kuno menyebutnya keluar dari sungai membawa peta ketika seorang suci berada di atas takhta.
summary.en: According to the article, a longma revealed the Hetu to Fu Xi or Shun, and an ancient commentary says it comes out of the river carrying a map when a holy man is on the throne.

role.id: Longma dianggap pertanda baik.
role.en: The longma is regarded as a good omen.

summary.id: Taiping Imperial Reader disebut mencatat bahwa longma yang muncul pada 741 dianggap pertanda baik bagi Kaisar Xuanzong dari Tang.
summary.en: The Taiping Imperial Reader is said to record that a longma that appeared in 741 was considered a good omen for Emperor Xuanzong of Tang.

description.id: Seekor longma yang muncul pada 741 dianggap pertanda baik bagi Kaisar Xuanzong dari Tang.
description.en: A longma that appeared in 741 was considered a good omen for Emperor Xuanzong of Tang.

sources.title: 周禮/夏官司馬 (Zhouli, Xiaguan Sima)

claims.quote: The longma is a fabled winged horse with dragon scales in Chinese mythology. Seeing a longma was an omen of a legendary sage-ruler, particularly one of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.

statement.id: Longma adalah kuda bersayap dengan sisik naga dalam mitologi Tiongkok.
statement.en: Longma is a winged horse bearing dragon scales in Chinese mythology.

claims.quote: The longma is a fabled winged horse with dragon scales in Chinese mythology. Seeing a longma was an omen of a legendary sage-ruler, particularly one of the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.

statement.id: Kemunculannya dipandang sebagai pertanda seorang penguasa bijak.
statement.en: Its appearance is regarded as an omen of a sage ruler.

claims.quote: The Chinese word longma combines long (龍; "dragon") and ma (馬). Compare hema (河馬; 'river horse'; "hippopotamus") and haima (海馬; 'sea horse'; "seahorse"). In addition to naming the mythic creature, longma (龍馬; "dragon horse") can refer to an eminent person, such as in the four-character idiom 龍馬精神; longma jingshen; "vigorous spirit in old age".

statement.id: Namanya menggabungkan kata long untuk naga dan ma untuk kuda.
statement.en: Its name joins long for dragon with ma for horse.

claims.quote: Longma interconnects traditional Chinese beliefs about dragons and horses. An early example comes from the Zhouli (周禮; 'Rites of Zhou'), which differentiates names for horses of different heights, measured in the chi (尺; 'Chinese foot') (historically around 23–33 centimeters, see Chinese units of measurement).

statement.id: Zhouli menghubungkan penamaan naga dan kuda melalui kategori tinggi kuda.
statement.en: The Zhouli connects dragon and horse naming through categories of horse height.

claims.quote: 廋人：掌十有二閑之政教，以阜馬、佚特、教駣、攻駒，及祭馬祖、祭閑之先牧，及執駒、散馬耳、圉馬。正校人員選。馬八尺以上為龍，七尺以上為騋，六尺以上為馬。

statement.id: Teks Zhouli menyebut kuda setinggi delapan chi ke atas disebut long (龍, naga), tujuh chi ke atas disebut lai (騋), dan enam chi ke atas disebut ma (馬, kuda).
statement.en: The Zhouli text says horses of eight chi and above are called long (龍, dragon), seven chi and above lai (騋), and six chi and above ma (馬, horse).

claims.quote: 故天降膏露，地出醴泉，山出器車，河出馬圖 ... 皆在郊棷，龜龍在宫沼

statement.id: Teks Liji menyebut bahwa ketika tata kelola selaras, antara lain "河出馬圖" (sungai mengeluarkan bagan kuda) terjadi, dan kura-kura serta naga (龜龍) berada di kolam istana.
statement.en: The Liji text says that when governance is in harmony, among other portents "the river brings forth the horse chart" (河出馬圖) and the tortoise and dragon (龜龍) are in the palace ponds.

claims.quote: As a being its shape consists of a horse's body, yet it has dragon scales. Therefore it is called 'dragon horse'. Its height is eight ch'ih five ts'un. A true dragon horse has wings at its sides and walks upon the water without sinking.

statement.id: Komentar kuno yang dikutip artikel ini menyatakan bahwa bentuknya bertubuh kuda tetapi bersisik naga, tingginya delapan chi lima cun, dan longma sejati bersayap di sisinya serta berjalan di atas air tanpa tenggelam.
statement.en: An ancient commentary quoted in the article states that its shape is a horse's body with dragon scales, its height is eight ch'ih five ts'un, and a true dragon horse has wings at its sides and walks on water without sinking.

claims.quote: If a holy man is on the throne it comes out of the midst of the Ming river, carrying a map on its back.

statement.id: Komentar yang sama menyatakan bahwa jika seorang suci berada di atas takhta, longma keluar dari tengah sungai sambil membawa peta di punggungnya.
statement.en: The same commentary states that if a holy man is on the throne, the dragon horse comes out of the midst of the river carrying a map on its back.

claims.quote: They are traditionally linked with prehistoric Chinese rulers, a longma revealed the Hetu to Fu Xi or Shun

statement.id: Menurut artikel ini, Hetu secara tradisional dikaitkan dengan penguasa Tiongkok prasejarah: seekor longma menyingkapkan Hetu kepada Fu Xi atau Shun.
statement.en: According to the article, the Hetu is traditionally linked with prehistoric Chinese rulers: a longma revealed the Hetu to Fu Xi or Shun.

claims.quote: The 10th-century Taiping Imperial Reader says a longma that appeared in 741 was considered as a good omen for Emperor Xuanzong of Tang. ... It was spotted blue and red, and covered with scales. Its mane resembled that of a dragon, and its neighing was like the tone of a flute. It could cover three hundred miles.

statement.id: Taiping Imperial Reader (abad ke-10) disebut menyatakan bahwa seekor longma yang muncul pada 741 dianggap pertanda baik bagi Kaisar Xuanzong dari Tang; ia berbintik biru dan merah, bersisik, surainya mirip naga, ringkikannya seperti suara seruling, dan mampu menempuh tiga ratus mil.
statement.en: The 10th-century Taiping Imperial Reader is said to state that a longma that appeared in 741 was considered a good omen for Emperor Xuanzong of Tang; it was spotted blue and red, covered with scales, had a dragon-like mane, neighed like a flute, and could cover three hundred miles.

claims.quote: Its mother was a common horse which had become pregnant by drinking water from a river in which it was bathed.

statement.id: Dalam catatan yang dikutip artikel ini, induk longma itu adalah kuda biasa yang hamil setelah meminum air sungai tempatnya dimandikan.
statement.en: In the account quoted in the article, the longma's mother was a common horse that became pregnant by drinking water from the river in which it was bathed.

claims.quote: The dragons, changing their form, couple with mares. The offspring is a wild species of horse (dragon-horse) difficult to tame and of a fierce nature.

statement.id: Kutipan dalam artikel ini mencatat cerita bahwa naga yang berganti wujud kawin dengan kuda betina dan keturunannya adalah kuda liar (kuda-naga) yang sulit dijinakkan dan bersifat garang.
statement.en: A passage quoted in the article records a story that dragons, changing form, couple with mares and the offspring is a wild horse (dragon-horse) difficult to tame and fierce in nature.

Zhouli (Xiaguan Sima) dan Liji (Liyun) di zh.wikisource.org dibuka dan dikutip. Shangshu Gumin (zh.wikisource) hanya menyebut Hetu tanpa kata longma; Yijing Xici dan Hanshu tidak ditemukan di zh.wikisource.

short_description.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote, sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal bersayap kelelawar. Ceritanya mungkin berasal dari kelelawar vampir.
short_description.en: The Piuchén is a blood-sucking creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology, often appearing as a flying snake or a bat-winged lizard. The lore may derive from the vampire bat.

long_description.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote yang dikenal di sebagian besar Chile. Ia sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar yang mengeluarkan siulan atau desis yang melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa. Ia juga digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran burung, ikan, dan manusia, atau pengubah wujud.
long_description.en: The Piuchén is a vampiric creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology known across much of Chile. It often appears as a flying snake or large bat-winged lizard whose whistles or hisses stun or kill prey. It has also been pictured as a composite of bird, fish and human, or as a shapeshifter that takes animal forms.

long_description.id: Menurut kisah Mapuche, ia terbang pada malam hari dan mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur di hutan, menyukai musim ketika pohon roble bertunas, dan dianggap roh hutan. Bentuknya berbeda-beda: ular bersayap berbulu di Vichuquén, ular hitam bersayap berbulu kaku di sekitar Santiago, atau makhluk berparuh beo, bertubuh kodok, dan berekor ular di Ovalle. Dalam cerita Chilote ia campuran manusia, ular, burung, dan ikan yang menghuni danau dan sungai, membangkitkan gelombang raksasa, dan merobohkan pohon besar.
long_description.en: In the Mapuche account it flies at night and sucks the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest, favors the season when roble trees sprout, and is regarded as a forest spirit. Its form varies: a serpent with feathered wings in Vichuquén, a black winged snake with a bristly body near Santiago, or a creature with a parrot's beak, toad-like body and snake-like tail in Ovalle. In Chilote lore it is a composite of human, snake, bird and fish that dwells in lakes and rivers, raises gigantic waves and knocks down huge trees.

long_description.id: Untuk melawannya, disarankan menyumbat lubang pohon tempat tinggalnya lalu membakar pohon itu; takhayul di Ovalle menganjurkan bendera putih atau bersiul ke dalam botol. Sumber menyebut machi bersekutu dengannya, tetapi juga diklaim hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkannya dengan ramuan herbal. Sebuah teks sejarah alam yang didigitalkan melukiskan "Piguchén" sebagai hewan bersayap selaput sebesar kelinci yang tidak mencelakai siapa pun selain serangga, dan ensiklopedia daring mencatat bahwa ceritanya mungkin berasal dari kelelawar vampir.
long_description.en: To fight it, it is suggested to plug the tree hollow where it lives and set the tree on fire; superstition in Ovalle recommends a white flag or whistling in a bottle. One source says the machi were in alliance with it, but it is also claimed that only the machi can defeat it with herbal cures. A digitized natural history text depicts the "Piguchén" as a rabbit-sized, membrane-winged animal that harms no one but insects, and the online encyclopedia notes that the lore may derive from the vampire bat.

origin.en: It comes from Mapuche and Chilote mythology and is known across much of Chile.

role.id: Ia dianggap roh hutan yang mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur.

description.id: Ia sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal bersayap kelelawar dan terbang pada malam hari.

claims.quote: is a vampiric creature from the Mapuche mythology and Chilote mythology known in much of  Chile.

statement.id: Piuchén adalah makhluk pengisap darah dari mitologi Mapuche dan Chilote yang dikenal di sebagian besar Chile.
statement.en: The Piuchén is a vampiric creature of Mapuche and Chilote mythology known across much of Chile.

claims.quote: This blood-sucker often assumes the guise of a flying snake, or a large lizard with bat wings, that emits strange whistling sounds or hisses that stun or kill its enemy or prey.

statement.id: Pengisap darah ini sering berwujud ular terbang atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar yang siulan atau desisnya melumpuhkan atau membunuh mangsa.
statement.en: It often appears as a flying snake or a bat-winged lizard whose whistles or hisses stun or kill prey.

claims.quote: The lore may have derived from encounters with the common vampire bat.

statement.id: Cerita ini mungkin berasal dari pertemuan dengan kelelawar vampir.
statement.en: The lore may come from encounters with the common vampire bat.

claims.quote: The Piuchén (Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén) or Piguchen (Piguchén)

statement.id: Piuchén juga ditulis Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén, atau Piguchen (Piguchén).
statement.en: The Piuchén is also written Peuchén, Pihuchén, Piwuchén, or Piguchen (Piguchén).

claims.quote: The name Piuchén (Piuchénes) derives from Mapuche Piwichen (also styled piwicheñ, pihuicheñ) for "mythic bird, bat" or "flying serpent". The piwichen may further break down into piwn 'to dry' + ché 'people'.

statement.id: Nama Piuchén berasal dari kata Mapuche Piwichen untuk "burung mitos, kelelawar" atau "ular terbang"; kata itu mungkin terurai menjadi piwn "mengeringkan" + ché "orang".
statement.en: The name Piuchén derives from Mapuche Piwichen for "mythic bird, bat" or "flying serpent"; the word may break down into piwn "to dry" + ché "people".

claims.quote: It is also described as an avian-piscine-human composite, or a shapeshifter taking on the form of animals.

statement.id: Ia juga digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran burung, ikan, dan manusia, atau pengubah wujud yang mengambil bentuk hewan.
statement.en: It is also described as an avian-piscine-human composite, or a shapeshifter taking on the form of animals.

claims.quote: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest. It prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts, and is considered a forest spirit.

statement.id: Ia terbang pada malam hari dan mengisap darah hewan dan manusia yang tertidur di hutan; ia menyukai musim ketika pohon roble bertunas dan dianggap roh hutan.
statement.en: It flies off at night, sucking the blood of animals and humans asleep in the forest; it prefers the season when the roble tree sprouts and is considered a forest spirit.

claims.quote: In various versions with local variations, it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or alternatively a large lizard with bat wings.

statement.id: Dalam berbagai versi lokal, ia dapat berupa ular bersayap berbulu (seperti diceritakan di Vichuquén) atau kadal besar bersayap kelelawar.
statement.en: In various local versions it may be a serpent with feathered wings (as told in Vichuquén), or a large lizard with bat wings.

claims.quote: The Pihuchén is a black winged snake about 0.5 metres (1.6 ft) in length, with a bristly body, according to the lore in the vicinity of Santiago, whose cattle fell victim.

statement.id: Menurut cerita di sekitar Santiago, Pihuchén adalah ular hitam bersayap sepanjang sekitar 0,5 meter dengan tubuh berbulu kaku, yang memangsa ternak.
statement.en: According to lore near Santiago, the Pihuchén is a black winged snake about 0.5 metres long with a bristly body, whose victims were cattle.

claims.quote: The informant stated the bristles were deadly poison upon contact with skin, making (live) capture an impossible task, hence the eradication by fire without handling the beast.

statement.id: Narasumber menyatakan bulu kakunya mematikan bila menyentuh kulit sehingga menangkapnya hidup-hidup mustahil, maka makhluk itu dibasmi dengan api tanpa disentuh.
statement.en: The informant stated the bristles were deadly poison on contact with skin, making live capture impossible, hence eradication by fire without handling the beast.

claims.quote: The creature enjoys incredible longevity, and in old age, the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized bird, or a young turkey sized bird.

statement.id: Makhluk ini berumur sangat panjang, dan di usia tua ular bersayap itu dapat berubah menjadi burung sebesar ayam jantan atau kalkun muda.
statement.en: The creature enjoys incredible longevity, and in old age the winged serpent may transform into a rooster-sized or young-turkey-sized bird.

claims.quote: In another telling from Ovalle in the Coquimbo Region, the Piuchén "has a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail".

statement.id: Dalam versi lain dari Ovalle di Wilayah Coquimbo, Piuchén "berparuh dan bersayap beo, bertubuh seperti kodok, dan berekor seperti ular".
statement.en: In another telling from Ovalle in the Coquimbo Region, the Piuchén "has a parrot's beak and wings, a toad-like body and a snake-like tail".

claims.quote: Others considered its hiss and gaze capable of killing prey, or the gaze may paralyze the victim and the creature then leisurely feeds on the blood of the stupefied victim.

statement.id: Sebagian menganggap desis dan tatapannya dapat membunuh mangsa, atau tatapannya melumpuhkan korban sehingga makhluk itu santai mengisap darahnya.
statement.en: Others considered its hiss and gaze capable of killing prey, or the gaze may paralyze the victim so the creature leisurely feeds on its blood.

claims.quote: In Chilote folklore, the creature is described as a protean composite creature, part human, snake, bird, and fish, and covered with all sorts of things such as grass, bushes, and twisted horn-like protrusions

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Chilote, makhluk ini digambarkan sebagai makhluk campuran yang berubah-ubah, sebagian manusia, ular, burung, dan ikan, tertutup rumput, semak, dan tonjolan seperti tanduk yang berpilin.
statement.en: In Chilote folklore the creature is described as a protean composite, part human, snake, bird and fish, covered with grass, bushes and twisted horn-like protrusions.

claims.quote: preferring to dwell in lakes and rivers, haunting the local Lake Huillinco. It allegedly can raise gigantic waves that cause nearby boats to sink.

statement.id: Ia lebih suka tinggal di danau dan sungai serta menghantui Danau Huillinco setempat; konon ia dapat membangkitkan gelombang raksasa yang menenggelamkan perahu di dekatnya.
statement.en: It prefers to dwell in lakes and rivers, haunting the local Lake Huillinco, and can allegedly raise gigantic waves that sink nearby boats.

claims.quote: The piuchén is so powerful it effortlessly knocks down this Chilean larch (alerces), the tique ... or other huge trees, according to Chilote lore

statement.id: Menurut cerita Chilote, piuchén begitu kuat sehingga tanpa kesulitan merobohkan alerce (cemara Chile), tique, atau pohon raksasa lain.
statement.en: According to Chilote lore the piuchén is so powerful it effortlessly knocks down the Chilean larch (alerces), the tique or other huge trees.

claims.quote: it is also claimed that only the machi alone can defeat the creature, as he or she can counteract the hypnosis with herbal cures.

statement.id: Juga diklaim bahwa hanya machi yang dapat mengalahkan makhluk itu karena ia dapat menangkal hipnosis dengan ramuan herbal.
statement.en: It is also claimed that only the machi can defeat the creature, as he or she can counteract the hypnosis with herbal cures.

claims.quote: Mapuche belief was that the Pihuichéñ coordinated its attacks with the machi (herbal healer), and they were in alliance

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan Mapuche, Pihuichéñ mengoordinasikan serangannya dengan machi (tabib herbal) dan keduanya bersekutu.
statement.en: According to Mapuche belief the Pihuichéñ coordinated its attacks with the machi (herbal healer), and they were in alliance.

claims.quote: to kill a Pihuchén living in a Tree hollow (hueco), it is suggested the hole be plugged with hefty cloth then to set the tree on fire.

statement.id: Untuk membunuh Pihuchén yang tinggal di lubang pohon, disarankan menyumbat lubang dengan kain tebal lalu membakar pohonnya.
statement.en: To kill a Pihuchén living in a tree hollow, it is suggested to plug the hole with heavy cloth and then set the tree on fire.

claims.quote: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward the creature off, and adds that adding white goat to one's flock diminishes the chance of being attacked.

statement.id: Takhayul di Ovalle menganjurkan mengibarkan bendera putih atau bersiul ke dalam botol untuk menangkal makhluk itu, dan menambah kambing putih ke kawanan mengurangi peluang diserang.
statement.en: Superstition in Ovalle recommends waving a white flag or whistling in a bottle to ward the creature off, and adding a white goat to one's flock lessens the chance of attack.

claims.quote: According to modern zoologists, this species name is a disused synonym of Desmodus rotundus, the common vampire bat, also known by the Spanish vernacular "Piuchén".

statement.en: According to modern zoologists this species name is a disused synonym of Desmodus rotundus, the common vampire bat, also known by the Spanish vernacular "Piuchén".

claims.quote: The abbot Juan Ignacio Molina also wrote a paragraph on the "winged quadruped, or a kind of large bat". A later lexicographer remarked that Molina had been deceived by a gift of some dead rare animal claimed to be a piuchén, and the abbot only described such cadaver in detail.

statement.id: Abbé Juan Ignacio Molina juga menulis satu paragraf tentang "kuadruped bersayap, atau sejenis kelelawar besar"; seorang leksikograf kemudian menyatakan Molina tertipu oleh hadiah bangkai hewan langka yang diklaim sebagai piuchén sehingga ia hanya menggambarkan bangkai itu.
statement.en: The abbot Juan Ignacio Molina also wrote a paragraph on the "winged quadruped, or a kind of large bat"; a later lexicographer remarked that Molina had been deceived by a gift of a dead rare animal claimed to be a piuchén and only described that cadaver.

claims.quote: He wonders if the Piguchén might have been the precursor of the Chupacabra.
