short_description.id: Jiaolong adalah naga mirip ular dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang dikaitkan dengan perairan, disebut bersisik dan dalam sebagian sumber tanpa tanduk.
short_description.en: Jiaolong is a serpent-like dragon of Chinese mythology associated with water, described as scaled and, in some sources, hornless.

long_description.id: Jiaolong adalah naga mirip ular dalam mitologi Tiongkok yang dikaitkan dengan perairan. Sebagian penafsiran menggambarkannya tanpa tanduk.
long_description.en: Jiaolong is a serpentine Chinese mythological dragon associated with water. Certain scholars describe the scaled dragon as hornless.

long_description.id: Sejumlah peneliti mengusulkan asal tradisi dari kelompok selatan non-Sinitik. Teks kuno menyebut tato masyarakat Yue sebagai perlindungan dari makhluk ini. Terjemahan jiao meliputi naga banjir, naga bersisik, dan buaya. Padanan namanya meliputi kōryū dalam bahasa Jepang dan giao long dalam bahasa Vietnam.
long_description.en: Some scholars propose southern non-Sinitic origins for the tradition. Ancient texts describe Yue tattoos as protection against these creatures. Translations of jiao include flood dragon, scaled dragon, and crocodile. Equivalent names include Japanese kōryū and Vietnamese giao long.

long_description.id: Teks-teks lama menggambarkan jiao sebagai makhluk perairan. Sumber-sumber menyebutnya penguasa makhluk air, dan sebuah kamus klasik mengisahkannya memimpin ikan terbang dari kolam yang penuh. Menurut satu sumber, orang percaya banjir terjadi ketika jiao menetas. Komentar Guo Pu menyebut jiao dapat menelan manusia.
long_description.en: Old texts describe the jiao as a creature of the waters. Sources call it lord of aquatic beings, and a classical dictionary says it leads fish away from a pond that is full of them. According to one source, people believed flooding resulted when jiao hatched. Guo Pu's commentary says the jiao could swallow a person.

long_description.id: Rupa jiao dalam Bencao Gangmu: mirip ular tetapi berkaki empat, berkepala kecil dan berleher ramping. Kamus Shuowen Jiezi dan kamus Piya mengartikannya sebagai sejenis naga, dan kamus Piya menambahkan bahwa jiao bertelur. Dalam pembagian yang dikutip kitab itu, jenis bersisik disebut jiaolong.
long_description.en: In the Bencao Gangmu the jiao looks like a snake but has four feet, a small head and a thin neck. The Shuowen Jiezi and Piya dictionaries define it as a kind of dragon, and the Piya adds that the jiao hatch from eggs. In the division quoted by that work, the scaled kind is called jiaolong.

long_description.id: Dalam legenda Festival Perahu Naga, kue beras yang dipersembahkan di sungai dimakan naga jiaolong, sehingga kue perlu dibungkus daun chinaberry dan diikat benang berwarna, dua hal yang dibenci naga. Sebuah teks kamus juga menyebut sang jiao pergi bila bubu ikan dipasang di air.
long_description.en: In the Dragon Boat Festival legend, rice cakes offered in the river were eaten by the jiaolong dragons, so the cakes had to be wrapped in chinaberry leaves and tied with colored strings, two things the dragons abhor. A dictionary text also says the jiao leaves when a fish trap is set in the water.

description.id: Menurut teks kamus klasik, jiao datang sebagai pemimpin ikan di kolam yang penuh ikan dan dapat membawa mereka terbang.
description.en: According to a classical dictionary text, the jiao comes as leader of the fish in a pond full of fish and can take them flying away.

description.id: Komentar Guo Pu menyebut jiao besar dapat menelan seseorang bulat-bulat.
description.en: Guo Pu's commentary says large jiao could swallow a person whole.

description.id: Menurut teks kamus klasik, jiao pergi bila bubu ikan dipasang di air.

description.id: Dalam legenda Festival Perahu Naga, dua benda ini dibenci naga jiaolong.

It may have referred to a species of crocodile.

statement.en: According to a passage from Pei Yuan quoted in Li Shizhen's Bencao Gangmu, the jiao is over a zhang long, snake-like but four-legged, with a small head and thin neck bearing white tassels, a sienna chest, blue-green spots on its back, and fleshy rings on its tail.

statement.en: The Bencao Gangmu cites Ren Fang: the jiao belongs to the dragons and is so named because its eyebrows grow crossed; the scaled kind is jiaolong, the winged kind yinglong, the horned kind qiulong, and the hornless kind chilong.

short_description.id: Kukulkan adalah dewa ular berbulu dalam mitologi Maya, dikaitkan erat dengan Quetzalcoatl bangsa Aztec. Ia dianggap dewa pencipta dan pembawa hujan serta angin, dengan kuil besar di Chichen Itza.
short_description.en: Kukulkan is the feathered serpent deity of Maya mythology, closely related to the Aztec Quetzalcoatl. He was seen as a creator god who brought rain and winds, with a large temple at Chichen Itza.

long_description.id: Kukulkan adalah dewa ular dalam mitologi Maya dan sangat berkaitan dengan dewa Qʼuqʼumatz dari bangsa Kʼicheʼ serta Quetzalcoatl dalam mitologi Aztec. Namanya berarti harfiah 'ular berbulu'. Ia juga diidentifikasi sebagai Quetzalcóatl oleh bangsa Toltec dan Aztec, sebagai Gucumatz oleh Maya Quiché di Guatemala, dan sebagai Ehecatl, dewa angin bangsa Huastec.
long_description.en: Kukulkan is the serpent deity of Maya mythology, with close ties to Qʼuqʼumatz of the Kʼicheʼ and to Quetzalcoatl of Aztec mythology. His name literally means 'feathered snake'. The Toltecs and Aztecs identify him with Quetzalcóatl, the Quiché Maya of Guatemala with Gucumatz, and the Huastecs with Ehecatl, their wind god.

long_description.id: Dewa utama Maya Yucatec ini adalah dewa pencipta serta dewa hujan, angin, badai, dan kehidupan. Kuil-kuil terkemuka Kukulkan terdapat di situs arkeologi di semenanjung Yucatán, seperti Chichen Itza, Uxmal, dan Mayapan. El Castillo di Chichen Itza berfungsi sebagai kuilnya, dan upacara di puncaknya mencakup pengorbanan manusia.
long_description.en: The chief god of the Yucatec Maya, he was a creator and the god of rain, wind, storms, and life. Major temples to Kukulkan stand at archaeological sites on the Yucatán Peninsula, including Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan. El Castillo at Chichen Itza served as his temple, and ceremonies at its summit included human sacrifices.

long_description.id: Penggambaran ular berbulu hadir di budaya Mesoamerika lain. Meskipun sangat dimeksikanisasi, Kukulkan berakar pada bangsa Maya Periode Klasik, ketika ia dikenal sebagai Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, Ular Perang. Pemujaannya adalah agama Mesoamerika pertama yang melampaui sekat bahasa dan etnis lama dan memudahkan perdagangan damai, dan menyebar dari Chichen Itza hingga Dataran Tinggi Guatemala dan Belize utara.
long_description.en: Images of the Feathered Serpent also occur in other Mesoamerican cultures. Though strongly Mexicanised, Kukulkan began among the Classic Period Maya, who knew him as Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, the War Serpent. His cult was the first Mesoamerican religion to transcend the old linguistic and ethnic divisions and facilitated peaceful trade, and it spread from Chichen Itza as far as the Guatemalan Highlands and northern Belize.

long_description.id: Rujukan pada dewa ini bercampur dengan rujukan pada seorang tokoh historis bernama Kukulkan, pahlawan budaya yang menurut Maya Yucatec adalah penguasa atau pendeta dan datang ke atau mendirikan Chichen Itza pada abad ke-10. Dalam cerita rakyat modern, Kukulkan dituturkan sebagai ular bersayap yang berjalan di depan dewa hujan Chaac; bagi Maya Lacandon di Chiapas, ia adalah ular jahat peliharaan dewa matahari.
long_description.en: References to the deity are confused with references to a historical figure named Kukulkan, a cultural hero who the Yucatec Maya believed was a ruler or priest and who came to or founded Chichen Itza in the 10th century. In modern folklore Kukulkan is told of as a winged serpent that travels ahead of the rain god Chaac; to the Lacandon Maya of Chiapas he is an evil snake, the pet of the sun god.

cultural_context.id: Pemujaan Kukulkan/Quetzalcoatl memudahkan komunikasi dan perdagangan damai antara masyarakat dari beragam latar sosial dan etnis.
cultural_context.en: Worship of Kukulkan/Quetzalcoatl eased contact and peaceful commerce among peoples of many social and ethnic backgrounds.

statement.en: It is closely related to the deity Qʼuqʼumatz of the Kʼicheʼ people and to Quetzalcoatl of Aztec mythology.

claims.quote: Prominent temples to Kukulkan are found at archaeological sites in the Yucatán Peninsula, such as Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan.

statement.id: Kuil untuk Kukulkan ditemukan di situs arkeologi Chichen Itza, Uxmal, dan Mayapan.
statement.en: Prominent temples to Kukulkan are found at archaeological sites in the Yucatán Peninsula, such as Chichen Itza, Uxmal and Mayapan.

claims.quote: The depiction of the Feathered Serpent is present in other cultures of Mesoamerica.

statement.id: Penggambaran Ular Bersayap ada dalam kebudayaan lain di Mesoamerika.
statement.en: The depiction of the Feathered Serpent is present in other cultures of Mesoamerica.

claims.quote: Although heavily Mexicanised, Kukulkan has its origins among the Maya of the Classic Period.

statement.id: Meskipun sangat dipengaruhi budaya Meksiko, Kukulkan berakar dari bangsa Maya Periode Klasik.
statement.en: Although heavily Mexicanised, Kukulkan has its origins among the Maya of the Classic Period.

claims.quote: The Yucatec form of the name is formed from the word kuk "feather" with the adjectival suffix -ul, giving kukul "feathered", combined with kan "snake" (Tzotzil chon), giving a literal meaning of "feathered snake".

statement.id: Bentuk Yucatec dari nama itu dibentuk dari kata kuk 'bulu' dengan akhiran sifat -ul sehingga menjadi kukul 'berbulu', digabung dengan kan 'ular', yang berarti harfiah 'ular berbulu'.
statement.en: The Yucatec form of the name is formed from the word kuk 'feather' with the adjectival suffix -ul, giving kukul 'feathered', combined with kan 'snake', giving a literal meaning of 'feathered snake'.

claims.quote: Kukulkan has its origins among the Maya of the Classic Period, when it was known as Waxaklahun Ubah Kan ... the War Serpent.

statement.id: Kukulkan berakar pada bangsa Maya Periode Klasik, ketika ia dikenal sebagai Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, Ular Perang.
statement.en: Kukulkan has its origins among the Maya of the Classic Period, when it was known as Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, the War Serpent.

claims.quote: The cult of Kukulkan/Quetzalcoatl was the first Mesoamerican religion to transcend the old Classic Period linguistic and ethnic divisions. This cult facilitated communication and peaceful trade among peoples of many different social and ethnic backgrounds.

statement.id: Pemujaan Kukulkan/Quetzalcoatl adalah agama Mesoamerika pertama yang melampaui sekat bahasa dan etnis Periode Klasik, dan memudahkan komunikasi serta perdagangan damai antara masyarakat dari beragam latar sosial dan etnis.
statement.en: The cult of Kukulkan/Quetzalcoatl was the first Mesoamerican religion to transcend the old Classic Period linguistic and ethnic divisions and facilitated communication and peaceful trade among peoples of many different social and ethnic backgrounds.

claims.quote: The cult of Kukulkan/Quetzalcoatl ... Although the cult was originally centred on the ancient city of Chichen Itza in the modern Mexican state of Yucatán, it spread as far as the Guatemalan Highlands and northern Belize.

statement.id: Pemujaan itu semula berpusat di kota kuno Chichen Itza di negara bagian Yucatán, Meksiko modern, lalu menyebar sampai Dataran Tinggi Guatemala dan Belize utara.
statement.en: The cult was originally centred on the ancient city of Chichen Itza in the modern Mexican state of Yucatán and spread as far as the Guatemalan Highlands and northern Belize.

claims.quote: In Yucatán, references to the deity Kukulkan are confused by references to a historical individual who bore the name of the god. ... This individual appears to have been a ruler or priest at Chichen Itza who first appeared around the 10th century.

statement.id: Di Yucatán, rujukan pada dewa Kukulkan bercampur dengan rujukan pada seorang tokoh historis yang memakai nama sang dewa; tokoh ini tampaknya penguasa atau pendeta di Chichen Itza yang pertama muncul sekitar abad ke-10.
statement.en: In Yucatán, references to the deity Kukulkan are confused with references to a historical individual who bore the god's name, who appears to have been a ruler or priest at Chichen Itza who first appeared around the 10th century.

claims.quote: El Castillo, Chichen Itza served as a temple to Kukulkan. During the spring and fall equinoxes the shadow cast by the angle of the sun and edges of the nine steps of the pyramid combined with the northern stairway and the stone serpent head carvings create the illusion of a massive serpent descending the pyramid.

statement.id: El Castillo di Chichen Itza berfungsi sebagai kuil Kukulkan. Pada ekuinoks musim semi dan gugur, bayangan dari sudut matahari dan tepi sembilan undakan piramida, dipadukan dengan tangga utara dan ukiran kepala ular batu, menciptakan ilusi ular raksasa yang menuruni piramida.
statement.en: El Castillo at Chichen Itza served as a temple to Kukulkan. At the spring and fall equinoxes the shadow cast by the sun on the edges of the nine steps of the pyramid, combined with the northern stairway and the stone serpent head carvings, creates the illusion of a massive serpent descending the pyramid.

claims.quote: A modern collection of folklore from Yucatán tells how Kukulkan was a winged serpent that flew to the sun and tried to speak to it but the sun, in its pride, burnt his tongue. The same source relates how Kukulkan always travels ahead of the Yucatec Maya rain god Chaac, helping to predict the rains as his tail moves the winds and sweeps the earth clean.

statement.id: Kumpulan cerita rakyat modern dari Yucatán menuturkan Kukulkan sebagai ular bersayap yang terbang ke matahari dan mencoba berbicara dengannya, tetapi matahari yang congkak membakar lidahnya. Sumber yang sama menyebut Kukulkan selalu berjalan di depan dewa hujan Maya Yucatec, Chaac, membantu meramalkan hujan karena ekornya menggerakkan angin dan menyapu bumi hingga bersih.
statement.en: A modern collection of folklore from Yucatán tells how Kukulkan was a winged serpent that flew to the sun and tried to speak to it, but the sun, in its pride, burnt his tongue; the same source says Kukulkan always travels ahead of the Yucatec Maya rain god Chaac, helping to predict the rains as his tail moves the winds and sweeps the earth clean.

claims.quote: Among the Lacandon Maya of Chiapas, Kukulkan is an evil, monstrous snake that is the pet of the sun god.

statement.id: Di kalangan Maya Lacandon di Chiapas, Kukulkan adalah ular jahat dan menyeramkan yang menjadi peliharaan dewa matahari.
statement.en: Among the Lacandon Maya of Chiapas, Kukulkan is an evil, monstrous snake that is the pet of the sun god.

claims.quote: In one tale, Kukulkan is a boy who was born as a snake. As he grew older it became obvious that he was the plumed serpent and his sister cared for him in a cave.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, Kukulkan adalah anak lelaki yang lahir sebagai ular; seiring ia tumbuh, jelas bahwa ia adalah ular berbulu, dan saudara perempuannya merawatnya di sebuah gua.
statement.en: In one tale, Kukulkan is a boy who was born as a snake; as he grew older it became obvious that he was the plumed serpent, and his sister cared for him in a cave.

claims.quote: In the 2006 film Apocalypto, the high priest in charge of human sacrifice prays to Kukulkan.

statement.id: Dalam film Apocalypto (2006), imam agung yang bertanggung jawab atas pengorbanan manusia berdoa kepada Kukulkan.
statement.en: In the 2006 film Apocalypto, the high priest in charge of human sacrifice prays to Kukulkan.

claims.quote: In the 2002 video game Serious Sam: The Second Encounter, Kukulkan serves as a guardian of the time portal in Teotihuacan and is fought as that game's first boss.

statement.id: Dalam gim video Serious Sam: The Second Encounter (2002), Kukulkan menjadi penjaga portal waktu di Teotihuacan dan dilawan sebagai bos pertama gim itu.
statement.en: In the 2002 video game Serious Sam: The Second Encounter, Kukulkan serves as a guardian of the time portal in Teotihuacan and is fought as that game's first boss.

claims.quote: Kukulcan (pron. Koo-kool-kan) is the name of a feathered serpent god in the mythology and religion of Mesoamerica, in particular, the Yucatec Maya. He is also identified as the feathered serpent god Quetzalcóatl by the Toltecs and Aztecs, as Gucumatz to the Quiché Maya of Guatemala, and Ehecatl, the wind god of the Huastecs of the Gulf Coast.

statement.id: Kukulcan adalah nama dewa ular berbulu dalam mitologi dan agama Mesoamerika, khususnya Maya Yucatec. Ia juga diidentifikasi sebagai dewa ular berbulu Quetzalcóatl oleh bangsa Toltec dan Aztec, sebagai Gucumatz oleh Maya Quiché di Guatemala, dan sebagai Ehecatl, dewa angin bangsa Huastec di Pesisir Teluk.
statement.en: Kukulcan is the name of a feathered serpent god in the mythology and religion of Mesoamerica, in particular the Yucatec Maya; he is also identified as Quetzalcóatl by the Toltecs and Aztecs, as Gucumatz to the Quiché Maya of Guatemala, and as Ehecatl, the wind god of the Huastecs of the Gulf Coast.

claims.quote: The Yucatec Maya were (and still are) speakers of the Yucatec language, and they settled the Yucatan peninsula in the north of ancient Mesoamerica. Their chief god was the feathered serpent Kukulcan whose name means just that: feathered (k'uk'ul) and serpent (kan). He was a creator god, and the god of rain, wind, storms, and life.

statement.id: Dewa utama Maya Yucatec, yang menetap di semenanjung Yucatan di utara Mesoamerika kuno, adalah ular berbulu Kukulcan, yang namanya berarti 'berbulu' (k'uk'ul) dan 'ular' (kan). Ia adalah dewa pencipta serta dewa hujan, angin, badai, dan kehidupan.
statement.en: The chief god of the Yucatec Maya, who settled the Yucatan peninsula in the north of ancient Mesoamerica, was the feathered serpent Kukulcan, whose name means feathered (k'uk'ul) and serpent (kan); he was a creator god and the god of rain, wind, storms, and life.

claims.quote: Kukulcan and his other manifestations are all unified by the belief that each was considered a creator god and a bringer of rain and winds. The god is particularly associated with Chichen Itza where a large temple was built in his honour.

statement.id: Kukulcan dan wujud-wujud lainnya dipersatukan oleh keyakinan bahwa masing-masing dianggap dewa pencipta dan pembawa hujan serta angin. Sang dewa terutama dikaitkan dengan Chichen Itza, tempat kuil besar dibangun untuk menghormatinya.
statement.en: Kukulcan and his other manifestations are unified by the belief that each was considered a creator god and a bringer of rain and winds; the god is particularly associated with Chichen Itza, where a large temple was built in his honour.

claims.quote: In addition to the god Kukulcan, the Yucatec Maya believed that a man called Kukulcan - a cultural hero who is either a ruler or priest - had, some time in the 10th century CE (perhaps 987 CE), come to or even founded Chichen Itza in the northern tip of the Yucatan peninsula.

statement.id: Selain dewa Kukulcan, Maya Yucatec meyakini seorang pria bernama Kukulcan, pahlawan budaya yang berstatus penguasa atau pendeta, pada suatu waktu di abad ke-10 M (mungkin 987 M) datang ke atau bahkan mendirikan Chichen Itza di ujung utara semenanjung Yucatan.
statement.en: In addition to the god Kukulcan, the Yucatec Maya believed that a man called Kukulcan, a cultural hero who is either a ruler or priest, had some time in the 10th century CE (perhaps 987 CE) come to or even founded Chichen Itza in the northern tip of the Yucatan peninsula.

claims.quote: A staircase on each side rises the nine levels to a summit where there is a small square structure consisting of two chambers. The pyramid is a marvel of architectural symmetry and design intention. Three stairways have 91 steps while the fourth has 92, making a total of 365, one step for each day of the year.

statement.id: Pada piramida itu, sebuah tangga di tiap sisi naik melalui sembilan tingkat ke puncak dengan bangunan persegi kecil berisi dua ruang. Tiga tangga memiliki 91 anak tangga dan yang keempat 92, sehingga totalnya 365, satu untuk setiap hari dalam setahun.
statement.en: On the pyramid, a staircase on each side rises the nine levels to a summit with a small square structure of two chambers; three stairways have 91 steps and the fourth has 92, making a total of 365, one step for each day of the year.

claims.quote: The platform at the pyramid's top was used for religious ceremonies in honour of Kukulcan which included human sacrifices, a reminder that in Mesoamerican culture the gods had to be continuously fed and appeased in order to ensure the continuance and prosperity of the human race.

statement.id: Pelataran di puncak piramida dipakai untuk upacara keagamaan menghormati Kukulcan yang mencakup pengorbanan manusia, pengingat bahwa dalam budaya Mesoamerika para dewa harus terus diberi makan dan ditenangkan demi kelangsungan dan kemakmuran umat manusia.
statement.en: The platform at the pyramid's top was used for religious ceremonies in honour of Kukulcan which included human sacrifices, a reminder that in Mesoamerican culture the gods had to be continuously fed and appeased to ensure the continuance and prosperity of the human race.

cultural_context.en: The limokon is not regarded as a spirit but as a messenger from the spirit world, and the omen bird is never killed because killing it would bring misfortune. Its voice is seen as a divine message from the envoy of the deities.

short_description.id: Limokon adalah burung pertanda bagi orang Mandaya, Bagobo, dan Manobo di Mindanao, burung merpati hutan yang suaranya dipercaya menyampaikan peringatan para roh.
short_description.en: The limokon is an omen bird of the Mandaya, Bagobo and Manobo of Mindanao, a wild pigeon whose call is believed to carry warnings from the spirits.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Filipina, orang Mandaya, Bagobo, dan Manobo di Mindanao meyakini limokon sebagai burung pertanda, seperti tigmamanukan bagi orang Tagalog di Luzon. Nama limokon kemungkinan dipakai untuk berbagai jenis merpati hutan di Filipina, sebagian di antaranya dianggap sakti atau sebagai burung pertanda. Sebuah catatan kaki dalam buku etnografi tentang orang Manobo mencantumkan nama Li-mo-kon dengan nama ilmiah Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale, yang umumnya disebut merpati buah.
long_description.en: In Philippine mythology, the Mandaya, Bagobo and Manobo of Mindanao believed the limokon to be an omen bird, like the tigmamanukan among the Tagalog of Luzon. The name limokon was likely applied to various wild pigeons in the Philippines, some considered magical or omen birds. A footnote in an ethnography of the Manobo gives the name Li-mo-kon with the scientific name Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale, generally called fruit dove.

long_description.id: Francisco Combes (1667) mencatat bahwa orang-orang sangat memercayai pertanda, antara lain dari burung seperti limocon. Menurut Fay Cooper Cole (1913), roh biasa berbicara kepada manusia lewat suara limokon, dan jual beli dihentikan bila burung itu memberi peringatan. Burung ini disebut juga limokan, dan Juan de Plasencia pada 1589 menyebut kepercayaan serupa pada orang Tagalog. Garvan menyebut burung ini dianggap pembawa pertanda baik dan buruk yang dimintai petunjuk pada awal setiap perjalanan dan usaha.
long_description.en: Francisco Combes (1667) recorded that the people firmly believed in omens, including from birds like the limocon. According to Fay Cooper Cole (1913), spirits commonly speak to mortals through the limokon's call, and a sale is stopped if the bird warns. It is also spelled limokan, and Juan de Plasencia mentioned similar beliefs among the Tagalog in 1589. Garvan says the bird is considered a harbinger of good and evil, consulted at the start of every journey and undertaking.

long_description.id: Bila limokon berbunyi ketika seseorang berada di jalan setapak, ia mengepalkan tinju dan mengacungkannya ke arah datangnya peringatan itu. Bila arah bunyinya tidak jelas, ia menoleh ke kanan dan memeriksa apakah pohon di sana kuat atau lemah. Orang Mandaya membaca arah tinju itu: ke kanan berarti keberhasilan, ke kiri, depan, atau belakang berarti peringatan akan bahaya atau kegagalan, sehingga tugas ditunda atau dibatalkan. Dalam satu kisah, para peladang meninggalkan lahan karena bunyi limokon di sebelah kiri pemilik tanah. Pada orang Mandaya di Cateel, arti kanan dan kiri disebut berlawanan.
long_description.en: When the limokon calls while someone is on the trail, he doubles his fist and thrusts it toward the direction of the warning. If the direction of the note is unclear, he looks to the right and checks whether the trees there are strong or weak. The Mandaya read the direction of the fist: right means success, left, front or back a warning of danger or failure, so the mission is delayed or given up. In one account, planters left a plot because the limokon called to the left of the landowner. Among the Mandaya of Cateel, right and left are said to mean the opposite.

long_description.id: Limokon tidak dianggap roh, melainkan utusan dari dunia roh, dan burung ini tidak pernah dibunuh karena membunuhnya akan mendatangkan kemalangan. Garvan juga menyebut burung pertanda ini dipelihara dalam sangkar untuk tujuan keagamaan dan dibujuk dengan makanan agar bernyanyi bagi pelancong. Menurut sebagian informan, lelaki dan perempuan pertama keluar dari telur limokon.
long_description.en: The limokon is not regarded as a spirit but as a messenger from the spirit world, and the bird is never killed because killing it would bring misfortune. Garvan also says the omen bird is kept in cages for religious purposes and coaxed with food to sing for the traveler. According to some informants, the first man and woman emerged from limokon eggs.

claims.quote: In Philippine mythology, the Limokon was believed by the Mandaya, Bagobo, and Manobo people of Mindanao to be an omen bird. In Luzon, a blue bird called the Tigmamanukan was similarly believed by the Tagalog people to be an omen bird.

statement.id: Orang Mandaya, Bagobo, dan Manobo di Mindanao meyakini limokon sebagai burung pertanda, seperti tigmamanukan bagi orang Tagalog di Luzon.
statement.en: The Mandaya, Bagobo and Manobo of Mindanao believed the limokon an omen bird, like the tigmamanukan among the Tagalog of Luzon.

claims.quote: What they believe in thoroughly are omens, which are almost general in all the islands. There are many of them: of birds, like the limocon

statement.id: Francisco Combes (1667) mencatat bahwa orang-orang sangat memercayai pertanda, antara lain dari burung seperti limocon.
statement.en: Francisco Combes (1667) recorded that the people firmly believed in omens, including from birds like the limocon.

claims.quote: Likely the term 'limokon' applied to various types of wild pigeons in the various languages in the Philippines, some of which were considered 'magical' and or 'omen birds'.

statement.id: Istilah limokon kemungkinan dipakai untuk berbagai merpati hutan dalam berbagai bahasa di Filipina, sebagian dianggap sakti atau burung pertanda.
statement.en: The term limokon likely named various wild pigeons in the Philippine languages, some thought magical or omen birds.

claims.quote: A common method used by the spirits to communicate with mortals is through the call of the limokon. All the people know the meaning of its calls and all respect its warnings. If a man is starting to buy or trade for an article and this bird gives its warning the sale is stopped.

statement.id: Menurut Fay Cooper Cole (1913), roh biasa berbicara kepada manusia lewat suara limokon; semua orang memahami dan menghormati peringatannya, dan jual beli dihentikan bila ia memberi peringatan.
statement.en: According to Fay Cooper Cole (1913), spirits commonly speak to mortals through the limokon's call; all understand and respect its warnings, and a sale is stopped if it warns.

claims.quote: Should the limokon call when a person is on the trail he at ones doubles his fist and thrusts it in the direction from which the warning comes.

statement.id: Jika limokon berbunyi ketika seseorang berada di jalan setapak, ia segera mengepalkan tinju dan mengacungkannya ke arah datangnya peringatan itu.
statement.en: If the limokon calls when a person is on the trail, he at once doubles his fist and thrusts it in the direction from which the warning comes.

claims.quote: When it is not clear from whence the note came, the traveler looks toward the right side. If he sees there strong, sturdy trees, he knows that all is well, but if they are cut or weaklings, he should use great care to avoid impending danger.

statement.id: Bila tidak jelas dari mana bunyinya datang, pelancong menoleh ke sisi kanan; jika di sana ada pohon yang kuat dan kokoh, semuanya baik, tetapi jika pohon itu ditebang atau lemah, ia harus sangat berhati-hati terhadap bahaya yang mengancam.
statement.en: When it is not clear where the note came from, the traveler looks to the right side; if he sees strong, sturdy trees there, all is well, but if they are cut or weak, he should take great care to avoid impending danger.

claims.quote: When questioned as to why one should look only to the right, an old man quickly replied: "The right side belongs to you; the left side is bad and belongs to someone else."

statement.id: Ketika ditanya mengapa orang hanya melihat ke kanan, seorang lelaki tua menjawab bahwa sisi kanan milik si pelancong, sedangkan sisi kiri buruk dan milik orang lain.
statement.en: Asked why one should look only to the right, an old man replied that the right side belongs to you, while the left side is bad and belongs to someone else.

claims.quote: Likewise, if the dove limokan calls on the left side of the trail the party will refuse to proceed, unless another limokan answers the call from the right side of the path.

statement.id: Jika merpati limokan (ejaan lain limokon) berbunyi di sisi kiri jalan, rombongan menolak melanjutkan perjalanan, kecuali limokan lain menjawab dari sisi kanan jalan.
statement.en: If the dove limokan (a variant spelling of limokon) calls on the left side of the trail, the party will refuse to proceed unless another limokan answers from the right side of the path.

claims.quote: This close relationship of the limokon to the Mandaya is given as the reason why its calls are given such heed. A traveler on the trail hearing the cooing of this bird at once doubles his fist and points it in the direction from whence the sound came.

statement.id: Hubungan dekat limokon dengan orang Mandaya disebut sebagai alasan mengapa bunyinya begitu diindahkan; pelancong yang mendengar kicau burung ini segera mengepalkan tinju dan mengarahkannya ke arah suara itu.
statement.en: The close relationship of the limokon to the Mandaya is given as the reason its calls are heeded so closely; a traveler hearing the cooing of this bird at once doubles his fist and points it toward the sound.

claims.quote: If, however, it points to the left, in front, or in back, the Mandaya knows that the omen bird is warning him of danger or failure, and he delays or gives up his mission.

statement.id: Jika tinjunya menunjuk ke kiri, depan, atau belakang, orang Mandaya tahu bahwa burung pertanda itu memperingatkannya tentang bahaya atau kegagalan, lalu ia menunda atau membatalkan tugasnya.
statement.en: If the fist points to the left, in front or behind, the Mandaya knows the omen bird is warning him of danger or failure, and he delays or gives up his mission.

claims.quote: They had labored about two hours when the call of the limokon was heard to the left of the owner. Without hesitation the men gathered up their tools and left the plot, explaining that it was useless for them to plant there for the limokon had warned them that rats would eat any crop they might try to grow in that spot.

statement.id: Setelah bekerja sekitar dua jam, bunyi limokon terdengar di sebelah kiri pemilik lahan; para lelaki itu segera mengemasi perkakas dan pergi, dengan alasan percuma menanam di sana karena limokon telah memperingatkan bahwa tikus akan memakan tanaman apa pun di tempat itu.
statement.en: After about two hours of work, the call of the limokon was heard to the left of the owner; the men at once gathered their tools and left, explaining it was useless to plant there because the limokon had warned that rats would eat any crop grown on that spot.

claims.quote: The people do not make offerings to this bird, neither do they regard it as a spirit, but rather as a messenger from the spirit world. The old men were certain that anyone who molested one of these birds would die.

statement.id: Orang-orang tidak memberi sesaji kepada burung ini dan tidak menganggapnya roh, melainkan utusan dari dunia roh; para tetua yakin siapa pun yang mengganggu burung ini akan mati.
statement.en: The people make no offerings to this bird and do not regard it as a spirit but as a messenger from the spirit world; the old men were certain that anyone who molested one of these birds would die.

claims.quote: Some informants stated that this is the name given to the first man and woman, who emerged from the limokon eggs.

statement.id: Beberapa informan menyatakan bahwa Magbabaya adalah nama bagi lelaki dan perempuan pertama, yang keluar dari telur limokon.
statement.en: Some informants stated that this is the name given to the first man and woman, who emerged from the limokon eggs.

claims.quote: The limokon warns or encourages the traveler, while certain acts of the individual, such as sneezing, are looked upon as warnings from unseen beings.

statement.id: Limokon memperingatkan atau menyemangati pelancong, sedangkan perbuatan tertentu seperti bersin dipandang sebagai peringatan dari makhluk tak kasatmata.
statement.en: The limokon warns or encourages the traveler, while certain acts of the individual, such as sneezing, are seen as warnings from unseen beings.

claims.quote: Similar beliefs held by the Tagalog were mentioned by Juan de Plasencia in 1589.

statement.id: Kepercayaan serupa pada orang Tagalog disebut oleh Juan de Plasencia pada 1589.
statement.en: Similar beliefs held by the Tagalog were mentioned by Juan de Plasencia in 1589.

claims.quote: Li-mo-kon. (Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale). Generally called fruit dove.

statement.id: Catatan kaki dalam buku ini mencantumkan nama Li-mo-kon dengan nama ilmiah Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale, yang umumnya disebut merpati buah.
statement.en: A footnote in this book gives the name Li-mo-kon with the scientific name Phabitreron brevirostris Tweedale, generally called fruit dove.

claims.quote: This homely inert creature is considered the harbinger of good and evil, and is consulted at the beginning of every journey and of every undertaking where its prophetic voice can be heard.

statement.id: Burung yang sederhana dan pendiam ini dianggap pembawa pertanda baik dan buruk, dan dimintai petunjuk pada awal setiap perjalanan dan setiap usaha di tempat suaranya yang bernubuat dapat terdengar.
statement.en: This homely, inert bird is considered the harbinger of good and evil, and is consulted at the start of every journey and undertaking where its prophetic voice can be heard.

claims.quote: Should its cry forebode ill, the undertaking is discontinued no matter how urgent it may be. But should the cry presage good, then the project is taken up or continued with renewed assurance and a glad heart

statement.id: Jika bunyinya menandakan celaka, usaha dihentikan seberapa pun mendesaknya; jika menandakan baik, usaha dimulai atau dilanjutkan dengan keyakinan baru dan hati gembira.
statement.en: If its cry forebodes ill, the undertaking is discontinued however urgent it may be; if the cry presages good, the project is taken up or continued with renewed assurance and a glad heart.

claims.quote: for is not this bird the envoy of the deities and its voice a divine message?

statement.id: Burung ini dipandang sebagai utusan para dewa, dan suaranya sebagai pesan ilahi.
statement.en: The bird is regarded as the envoy of the deities and its voice as a divine message.

claims.quote: The omen bird is never killed, for to kill it would draw down unmitigated misfortune.
claims.locator: Ornitoskopi, sikap hormat terhadap burung pertanda

statement.id: Burung pertanda tidak pernah dibunuh, karena membunuhnya akan mendatangkan kemalangan besar.
statement.en: The omen bird is never killed, because killing it would bring down great misfortune.

claims.quote: The cage is usually hung from the roof under the eaves outside the wall. The turtledove is kept for religious purposes

statement.id: Sangkar biasanya digantung pada atap di bawah cucuran atap di luar dinding, dan merpati tekukur dipelihara untuk tujuan keagamaan.
statement.en: The cage is usually hung from the roof under the eaves outside the wall, and the turtledove is kept for religious purposes.

claims.quote: The prospective traveler takes a little camote or banana and, placing it in the cage, addresses the captive bird and asks it to sing to its companions of the woods that they too in turn may sing to him the song of success and safe return.
claims.locator: Ornitoskopi, sikap hormat terhadap burung pertanda

statement.id: Calon pelancong menaruh sedikit ubi jalar atau pisang di sangkar dan meminta burung tangkapan itu bernyanyi kepada kawan-kawannya di hutan agar mereka pun menyanyikan lagu keberhasilan dan keselamatan pulang baginya.
statement.en: The prospective traveler places a little sweet potato or banana in the cage and asks the captive bird to sing to its companions in the woods so that they in turn may sing to him the song of success and safe return.

claims.quote: Maxey states exactly the opposite, for the Mandaya of Cateel, i. e., the right side is bad, the left good.

statement.id: Maxey menyatakan hal yang persis berlawanan bagi orang Mandaya di Cateel: sisi kanan buruk dan sisi kiri baik.
statement.en: Maxey states exactly the opposite for the Mandaya of Cateel: the right side is bad and the left good.

short_description.id: Medjed adalah ikan gajah yang dianggap suci dalam agama Mesir kuno dan dipuja di Oxyrhynchus; menurut mitos, ikan itu memakan penis Osiris.
short_description.en: The medjed is an elephantfish held sacred in ancient Egyptian religion and worshipped at Oxyrhynchus; in myth it ate the penis of Osiris.

long_description.id: Medjed adalah ikan suci Mesir kuno dari keluarga ikan gajah, dan terutama dipuja di kota Oxyrhynchus (Per-Medjed), yang nama Mesirnya berarti "Rumah Medjed". Nama Yunani Oxyrhynchus, yang berarti "berhidung tajam", mengacu pada penggambaran Mesir atas ikan itu.
long_description.en: The medjed is a sacred ancient Egyptian fish of the elephantfish family, worshipped mainly in the city of Oxyrhynchus (Per-Medjed), whose Egyptian name means "House of Medjed". The Greek name Oxyrhynchus, meaning "sharp-nosed", is a nod to the Egyptian depiction of the fish.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Mesir kuno, ikan ini menelan penis Osiris setelah Set memotong tubuhnya dan menyebarkannya ke seluruh Mesir. Dalam uraian Plutarkhos yang diterjemahkan Budge, Isis tidak pernah berhasil memulihkan bagian itu, sebab ikan Lepidotus, Phagrus, dan Oxyrhynchus telah memakannya; karena itu orang Mesir menjauhi ikan-ikan tersebut lebih dari ikan lain.
long_description.en: In ancient Egyptian mythology this fish swallowed the penis of Osiris after Set cut up his body and scattered it throughout Egypt. In Plutarch's account as translated by Budge, Isis could never recover that part, since fish called the Lepidotus, the Phagrus and the Oxyrhynchus had eaten it; for this reason the Egyptians shun those fish more than any others.

long_description.id: Sebagai ikan suci, ikan ini sering digambarkan mengenakan cakram matahari bertanduk, dan sebagian patung kecilnya memiliki cincin agar dapat dipakai sebagai jimat liontin. Patung perunggu, lukisan dinding, dan peti kayu berbentuk ikan dengan moncong menurun telah dideskripsikan menyerupai marga Mormyrus. Menurut Plutarkhos, penduduk Oxyrhynchus sangat menghormati ikan itu.
long_description.en: As a sacred fish it is frequently depicted wearing horned sun-discs, and some figurines have rings so that they can be worn as pendant amulets. Bronze figurines, mural paintings and wooden fish-shaped coffins with downturned snouts have been described as resembling the genus Mormyrus. According to Plutarch, the inhabitants of Oxyrhynchus pay especial reverence to the fish.

selection_criteria: computeFillStatus must be lengkap-informasi: complete, valid research without an approved image.
No active editorial artwork and no permanent artwork exclusion.
The accepted research entry is embedded unchanged; the image may only depict what its claims document.
Creatures an earlier batch left out keep that reason as catatan_sebelumnya; the generator may decline them with status tidak-digambar.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar. A calm scene without agency fails.
user_policy.self_check: Before accepting an image the generator answers all of these with yes: the being dominates the frame; it still looks dangerous or majestic at 200 px; there is a moment, not a static pose; each visible effect points to a claim id; head, eye and limb counts match the claims; no text, watermark, border or borrowed design; it would not be rejected as ordinary person, ordinary animal, landscape only, or cute and calm. One no means regenerate, keep the rejected attempt as history, up to three attempts.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly cinematic illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Every design is original and sourced from the accepted research.

Nama dewa saja tidak membenarkan naga beranggota empat, wajah manusia, mahkota atau pakaian. Tidak membuat lanskap air tanpa subjek yang akan gagal Uji Sangar.
